rotate: none; scale: none; transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;"><div class="u-section-divider"></div><div data-wf--spacer--section-space="main" class="u-section-spacer w-variant-60a7ad7d-02b0-6682-95a5-2218e6fd1490 u-ignore-trim"></div><div class="section_contain u-container u-margin-trim u-threshold-medium"><div data-animate-header-wrap="" data-wf--module-header-main--heading-style="h1" class="header_main_wrap u-margin-trim u-alignment-center"><div class="u-pictogram-wrap"><div class="header_icon"><div data-lottie-loop="true" data-lottie-component="" data-lottie-src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6889473510b50328dbb70ae6/68c2c5f078af5993ae430951_Node-SequenceCoding.lottie" class="pictogram_lottie_wrap" data-script-initialized="true"><div data-lottie-host="" class="pictogram_lottie"><dotlottie-player src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6889473510b50328dbb70ae6/68c2c5f078af5993ae430951_Node-SequenceCoding.lottie" renderer="svg" autoplay="false" loop="true" style="width: 100%; height: 100%;"></dotlottie-player></div><div class="u-embed-js w-embed w-script"><script>
  (function() {
    "use strict";

    /* ===================== Prevent double initialization ===================== */
    if (window.__pictogramLottieInitialized) return;
    window.__pictogramLottieInitialized = true;

    /* ===================== CONFIG ===================== */
    const COLOR_MAP = {
      fills: [
        { from: ["#131314", "rgb(19,19,20)", "rgb(19, 19, 20)", "#141413", "rgb(20,20,19)", "rgb(20, 20, 19)"],
         to: "var(--_theme---foreground-primary)" },
        { from: ["#DEDCD1", "rgb(222,220,209)", "rgb(222,220,209)", "#e3dacc", "rgb(227,218,204)", "rgb(227, 218, 204)"],
         to: "var(--_theme---pictogram-accent)" }
      ],
      strokes: [
        { from: ["#ff0000", "rgb(255,0,0)", "rgb(255, 0, 0)"],
         to: "var(--_theme---pictogram-accent)" }
      ]
    };

    const FORCE_MODE = true;
    const RECOLOR_FRAME_INTERVAL = 2;
    const LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL = 100;
    const LOTTIE_MAX_RETRIES = 50;

    /* ===================== Helpers ===================== */
    const normHex = (hex) => {
      const h = String(hex || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!h) return null;
      let v = h.startsWith("#") ? h.slice(1) : h;
      if (v.length === 3) v = v.split("").map(c => c + c).join("");
      if (v.length === 6) return "#" + v;
      if (v.length === 8) return "#" + v.slice(0, 6);
      return null;
    };

    const toHex2 = (n) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(n))).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");

    const normRgb = (rgb) => {
      const m = String(rgb || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").match(/^rgba?\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)(?:,([\d.]+))?\)$/i);
      if (!m) return null;
      return "#" + toHex2(+m[1]) + toHex2(+m[2]) + toHex2(+m[3]);
    };

    const normColor = (c) => {
      if (!c || /^none$/i.test(c)) return null;
      if (/^var\(/i.test(c)) return null;
      return normHex(c) || normRgb(c);
    };

    function buildPairs() {
      const fills = [];
      const strokes = [];
      COLOR_MAP.fills.forEach(({ from, to }) => {
        (Array.isArray(from) ? from : [from]).forEach(f => {
          const k = normColor(f);
          if (k) {
            const [r, g, b] = [k.slice(1, 3), k.slice(3, 5), k.slice(5, 7)].map(v => parseInt(v, 16));
            fills.push({ hex: k, rgbLoose: new RegExp(`rgb\\s*\\(\\s*${r}\\s*,\\s*${g}\\s*,\\s*${b}\\s*\\)`, "gi"), to });
          }
        });
      });
      COLOR_MAP.strokes.forEach(({ from, to }) => {
        (Array.isArray(from) ? from : [from]).forEach(f => {
          const k = normColor(f);
          if (k) {
            const [r, g, b] = [k.slice(1, 3), k.slice(3, 5), k.slice(5, 7)].map(v => parseInt(v, 16));
            strokes.push({ hex: k, rgbLoose: new RegExp(`rgb\\s*\\(\\s*${r}\\s*,\\s*${g}\\s*,\\s*${b}\\s*\\)`, "gi"), to });
          }
        });
      });
      return { fills, strokes };
    }

    function recolorSvg(svgRoot, pairs) {
      if (!svgRoot) return;
      const maybeSwap = (val, list) => {
        const n = normColor(val);
        if (!n) return null;
        const hit = list.find(p => p.hex === n);
        return hit ? hit.to : null;
      };

      svgRoot.querySelectorAll("path, rect, circle, ellipse, polygon, polyline, line, g, use").forEach(el => {
        const fAttr = el.getAttribute("fill");
        const fStyle = el.style && el.style.fill ? el.style.fill : null;
        const fTo = maybeSwap(fAttr, pairs.fills) || maybeSwap(fStyle, pairs.fills);
        if (fTo) { el.setAttribute("fill", fTo); if (el.style) el.style.fill = fTo; }

        const sAttr = el.getAttribute("stroke");
        const sStyle = el.style && el.style.stroke ? el.style.stroke : null;
        const sTo = maybeSwap(sAttr, pairs.strokes) || maybeSwap(sStyle, pairs.strokes);
        if (sTo) { el.setAttribute("stroke", sTo); if (el.style) el.style.stroke = sTo; }
      });

      svgRoot.querySelectorAll("stop").forEach(stop => {
        const scAttr = stop.getAttribute("stop-color");
        const scStyle = stop.style && stop.style.stopColor ? stop.style.stopColor : null;
        const fTo = maybeSwap(scAttr, pairs.fills) || maybeSwap(scStyle, pairs.fills);
        if (fTo) { stop.setAttribute("stop-color", fTo); if (stop.style) stop.style.stopColor = fTo; }
      });

      svgRoot.querySelectorAll("style").forEach(s => {
        const before = s.textContent || "";
        let css = before;
        pairs.fills.forEach(({ hex, rgbLoose, to }) => {
          css = css.replace(new RegExp(hex.replace('#', '\\#'), "gi"), to);
          css = css.replace(rgbLoose, to);
        });
        pairs.strokes.forEach(({ hex, rgbLoose, to }) => {
          css = css.replace(new RegExp(hex.replace('#', '\\#'), "gi"), to);
          css = css.replace(rgbLoose, to);
        });
        if (css !== before) s.textContent = css;
      });
    }

    /* ===================== Build color pairs once ===================== */
    const pairs = buildPairs();

    /* ===================== Reactive reduced motion preference ===================== */
    const reducedMotionQuery = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    let prefersReducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;

    const onReducedMotionChange = (e) => {
      prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
      if (prefersReducedMotion) {
        elementDataMap.forEach((data) => {
          if (data.api && data.api.isReady) data.api.pause();
        });
      } else {
        checkAllVisibleElements();
      }
    };

    if (reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener) {
      reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener("change", onReducedMotionChange);
    } else if (reducedMotionQuery.addListener) {
      reducedMotionQuery.addListener(onReducedMotionChange);
    }

    /* ===================== Element tracking ===================== */
    const elementDataMap = new Map();
    const pendingElements = new Set();

    /* ===================== Single RAF loop for all recoloring ===================== */
    let rafId = null;
    let frameCount = 0;

    function recolorLoop() {
      frameCount++;
      if (frameCount % RECOLOR_FRAME_INTERVAL === 0) {
        elementDataMap.forEach((data, root) => {
          if (root.isConnected && data.isVisible && data.svgRoot) {
            recolorSvg(data.svgRoot, pairs);
          }
        });
      }
      if (FORCE_MODE && elementDataMap.size > 0) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(recolorLoop);
      } else {
        rafId = null;
      }
    }

    function startRecolorLoop() {
      if (FORCE_MODE && rafId === null && elementDataMap.size > 0) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(recolorLoop);
      }
    }

    function stopRecolorLoopIfEmpty() {
      if (elementDataMap.size === 0 && rafId !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        rafId = null;
      }
    }

    /* ===================== Lottie library retry mechanism ===================== */
    let retryTimeoutId = null;
    let retryCount = 0;

    function isLottieAvailable() {
      return window.lottie && typeof window.lottie.loadAnimation === "function";
    }

    function processPendingElements() {
      if (pendingElements.size === 0) {
        retryTimeoutId = null;
        retryCount = 0;
        return;
      }

      if (isLottieAvailable()) {
        pendingElements.forEach(root => {
          if (root.isConnected) {
            delete root.dataset.scriptInitialized;
            initLottieElement(root);
          }
        });
        pendingElements.clear();
        retryTimeoutId = null;
        retryCount = 0;
        return;
      }

      retryCount++;
      if (retryCount >= LOTTIE_MAX_RETRIES) {
        console.warn("Pictogram Lottie: lottie-web library not available after " + (LOTTIE_MAX_RETRIES * LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL / 1000) + "s timeout");
        pendingElements.clear();
        retryTimeoutId = null;
        retryCount = 0;
        return;
      }

      retryTimeoutId = setTimeout(processPendingElements, LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL);
    }

    function queueForLottieRetry(root) {
      pendingElements.add(root);
      if (retryTimeoutId === null) {
        retryTimeoutId = setTimeout(processPendingElements, LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL);
      }
    }

    /* ===================== Per-element initialization ===================== */
    function initLottieElement(root) {
      if (root.dataset.scriptInitialized === "true" && !elementDataMap.has(root)) {
        delete root.dataset.scriptInitialized;
      }

      if (root.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
      root.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

      const OBS_ROOT_MARGIN = root.getAttribute("data-lottie-rootmargin") || "0px 0px -10% 0px";
      const OBS_THRESHOLD = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Number(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-threshold") || 0.2)));

      const src = root.getAttribute("data-lottie-src");
      if (!src) return;

      const loop = !/^(false|0|no)$/i.test(String(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-loop") || "true"));
      const rawSpeed = Number(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-speed") || 1);
      const speed = (rawSpeed > 0) ? rawSpeed : 1;
      const direction = Number(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-direction") || 1) === -1 ? -1 : 1;

      let host = root.querySelector("[data-lottie-host]");
      if (!host) {
        host = document.createElement("div");
        host.setAttribute("data-lottie-host", "");
        host.style.width = "100%";
        host.style.height = "100%";
        root.appendChild(host);
      }

      const isDotLottie = /\.lottie(\?|#|$)/i.test(src);
      const hasDot = typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !!customElements.get("dotlottie-player");

      if (!isDotLottie || !hasDot) {
        if (!isLottieAvailable()) {
          queueForLottieRetry(root);
          return;
        }
      }

      const data = {
        api: null,
        io: null,
        svgRoot: null,
        isVisible: false,
        anim: null,
        checkAndPlayIfVisible: null
      };

      function isElementInViewport() {
        const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
        const windowHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        const windowWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
        return (rect.top < windowHeight && rect.bottom > 0) && (rect.left < windowWidth && rect.right > 0);
      }

      function checkAndPlayIfVisible() {
        if (!data.api || !data.api.isReady) return;
        if (prefersReducedMotion) {
          data.api.pause();
          return;
        }
        if (isElementInViewport()) {
          data.isVisible = true;
          data.api.play();
        }
      }

      data.checkAndPlayIfVisible = checkAndPlayIfVisible;

      function handleLoadError(error) {
        console.warn("Lottie failed to load:", src, error);
        root.dataset.lottieError = "true";
      }

      function onAnimationReady(svgRoot) {
        data.api.isReady = true;
        data.api.setSpeed(speed);
        data.api.setDirection(direction);
        data.svgRoot = svgRoot;

        if (svgRoot) {
          recolorSvg(svgRoot, pairs);
          startRecolorLoop();
        }

        checkAndPlayIfVisible();
      }

      if (isDotLottie && hasDot) {
        const player = document.createElement("dotlottie-player");
        player.setAttribute("src", src);
        player.setAttribute("renderer", "svg");
        player.setAttribute("autoplay", "false");
        player.setAttribute("loop", loop ? "true" : "false");
        player.style.width = "100%";
        player.style.height = "100%";
        host.innerHTML = "";
        host.appendChild(player);

        data.api = {
          isReady: false,
          play() { try { player.play(); } catch (e) { } },
          pause() { try { player.pause(); } catch (e) { } },
          setSpeed(n) { try { player.speed = Number(n) || 1; } catch (e) { } },
          setDirection(d) { try { player.direction = (d === -1 ? -1 : 1); } catch (e) { } },
          destroy() { try { player.remove(); } catch (e) { } }
        };

        player.addEventListener("ready", () => {
          const svgRoot = player.shadowRoot && player.shadowRoot.querySelector("svg");
          onAnimationReady(svgRoot);
        });

        player.addEventListener("error", handleLoadError);

      } else {
        const anim = window.lottie.loadAnimation({
          container: host,
          renderer: "svg",
          loop,
          autoplay: false,
          path: src
        });

        data.anim = anim;

        data.api = {
          isReady: false,
          play() { try { anim.play(); } catch (e) { } },
          pause() { try { anim.pause(); } catch (e) { } },
          setSpeed(n) { try { anim.setSpeed(Number(n) || 1); } catch (e) { } },
          setDirection(d) { try { anim.setDirection(d === -1 ? -1 : 1); } catch (e) { } },
          destroy() { try { anim.destroy(); } catch (e) { } }
        };

        anim.addEventListener("DOMLoaded", () => {
          const svgRoot = host.querySelector("svg");
          onAnimationReady(svgRoot);
        });

        anim.addEventListener("data_failed", handleLoadError);
        anim.addEventListener("error", handleLoadError);
      }

      const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(e => {
          const inView = e.isIntersecting && e.intersectionRatio >= OBS_THRESHOLD;
          data.isVisible = inView;

          if (!data.api || !data.api.isReady) return;

          if (prefersReducedMotion) {
            data.api.pause();
            return;
          }

          inView ? data.api.play() : data.api.pause();
        });
      }, { root: null, rootMargin: OBS_ROOT_MARGIN, threshold: OBS_THRESHOLD });

      io.observe(root);
      data.io = io;

      elementDataMap.set(root, data);
    }

    function cleanupElement(el) {
      const data = elementDataMap.get(el);
      if (data) {
        if (data.io) {
          try { data.io.disconnect(); } catch (e) { }
        }
        if (data.api && data.api.destroy) {
          try { data.api.destroy(); } catch (e) { }
        }
        elementDataMap.delete(el);
        stopRecolorLoopIfEmpty();
      }
      pendingElements.delete(el);
    }

    function checkAllVisibleElements() {
      elementDataMap.forEach((data) => {
        if (data.api && data.api.isReady && data.checkAndPlayIfVisible) {
          data.checkAndPlayIfVisible();
        }
      });
    }

    function init() {
      document.querySelectorAll(".pictogram_lottie_wrap").forEach(initLottieElement);

      if (document.readyState === "complete") {
        checkAllVisibleElements();
      } else {
        window.addEventListener("load", checkAllVisibleElements, { once: true });
      }

      const domObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
          mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (node.matches && node.matches(".pictogram_lottie_wrap")) {
                initLottieElement(node);
              }
              if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                node.querySelectorAll(".pictogram_lottie_wrap").forEach(initLottieElement);
              }
            }
          });

          mutation.removedNodes.forEach((node) => {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (node.matches && node.matches(".pictogram_lottie_wrap")) {
                cleanupElement(node);
              }
              if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                node.querySelectorAll(".pictogram_lottie_wrap").forEach(cleanupElement);
              }
            }
          });
        });
      });

      domObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
    } else {
      init();
    }

    window.PictogramLottie = {
      refresh: checkAllVisibleElements,
      init: initLottieElement,
      cleanup: cleanupElement
    };

  })();
</script></div></div></div></div><div data-animate-header-heading="" class="c-heading-header u-child-contain u-mb-text w-richtext u-max-width-30ch"><h2 aria-label="The AI for problem solvers"><div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">The</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">AI</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">for</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">problem</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">solvers</div></h2></div><div data-animate-header-text="" class="header_main_text u-foreground-tertiary u-child-contain u-text-wrap-pretty w-richtext u-mb-text u-rich-text u-max-width-45ch" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;"><p>Use <a href="/product/cowork">Cowork</a> in the desktop app to hand off tasks.</p></div><div data-animate-header-cta="" class="header_main_cta" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;"><div data-wf--button-wrapper--mobile-styling="full-width-mobile" id="" class="u-display-contents"><div class="u-button-group w-variant-92fe68b6-7437-d0c6-3fc0-cc8114f8d03d"><div class="u-display-contents"><div class="download_links_wrap"><div class="u-embed-css w-embed"><style>

pocket, collaborating with Claude expands what you can build on your own or with teams.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="mindmap_wrap u-column-2"><div class="u-embed-css w-embed"><style>
  .mindmap_wrap {
    --background-primary: var(--_theme---background-primary);
    --background-tertiary: var(--_theme---background-tertiary);
    --foreground-primary: var(--_theme---foreground-primary);
    --font-mono: "Anthropic Mono", monospace;
    --font-sans: "Anthropic Sans", sans-serif;
    --font-serif: "Anthropic Serif", serif;
  }

  .mindmap {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    min-height: 800px;
    position: relative;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
  }

  @media (min-width: 640px) {
    .mindmap {
      min-height: 600px;
    }
  }

  .mindmap__logo {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    max-width: 180px;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  }
  .mindmap__logo::after {
    content: "";
    display: block;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: calc(100% + 100px);
    height: calc(100% + 60px);
    background-color: var(--background-primary);
    z-index: -1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    filter: blur(16px);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .mindmap__logo svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .mindmap__logo {
      max-width: 120px;
    }
    .mindmap__logo::after {
      max-width: calc(100% + 50px);
      max-height: calc(100% + 24px);
    }
  }

  .mindmap .categories text {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-family: var(--font-serif);
  }

  .mindmap .nodes text {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
  }

  .mindmap g {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mindmap g a {
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .mindmap__tooltip {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 25;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 190px;
    background-color: var(--_theme---background-primary);
    color: var(--foreground-primary);
    padding: 12px 10px;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    pointer-events: none;
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .mindmap__tooltip-heading {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
  }

  .mindmap__tooltip-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .mindmap__tooltip-body {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 120%;
    color: var(--foreground-primary);
    opacity: 0.6;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
</style></div><div class="w-embed"><div data-chart="" class="mindmap">

    <div data-tooltip-container="" class="tooltip-container"></div></div><div class="u-embed-js w-embed w-script"><script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script>
const tooltipItems = {
  Debugging: {
    heading: "Perfect code, every time",
    body: "JetBrains uses Claude to power Junie, achieving 100% syntactically correct code generation.",
    image:
      "https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/40ab6434838c7cd995e4ef74862e1df2d051f8b4-4800x2520.jpg",
    url: "https://claude.com/customers/jetbrains",
  },
  Visualizations: {
    heading: "Autonomous data insights",
    body: "Claude agents autonomously analyze massive datasets, delivering 50%+ KPI improvements for Triple Whale's brands.",
    image:
      "https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/150dfe21dd8e8ee77fe0edacc93765a038ee25bf-4800x2520.jpg",
    url: "https://claude.com/customers/triple-whale",
  },
  Queries: {
    heading: "4,000 employees, one platform",
    body: "Block employees solve data problems independently using Claude, saving engineers 8-10+ hours weekly.",
    image:
      "https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/c772aa1a4ce89077edc8731fcb832822ab77d4a3-4800x2520.jpg",
    url: "https://claude.com/customers/block",
  },
  Marketing: {
    heading: "Smarter ad campaigns",
    body: "Advolve uses Claude to manage millions of ads simultaneously with 90% less operational work.",
    image:
      "https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/777a5cbda7fbf7dede631821f6de45f12991ede6-4800x2520.jpg",
    url: "https://claude.com/customers/advolve",
  },
  Growth: {
    heading: "Enterprise AI transformation",
    body: "IG Group boosts productivity and saves operational costs with Claude.",
    image:
      "https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/1cb9e73bbea501aa7d268e93235cc9070023d0c3-4800x2520.jpg",
    url: "https://claude.com/customers/ig-group",
  },
  Prototypes: {
    heading: "From words to working apps",
    body: "Spring.new enables business teams to build functional applications using plain English descriptions.",
    image:
      "https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/92ed261f46696d6cd181408764ab5abd048a82f5-4800x2520.jpg",
    url: "https://claude.com/customers/spring-new",
  },
};

const categories = {
  "Software development": {
    items: ["Debugging", "Testing", "Optimization", "Documentation", "Reviews"],
  },
  "Data analysis": {
    items: ["Visualizations", "Queries", "Processing", "Reports", "Patterns"],
  },
  "Content creation": {
    items: [
      "Marketing",
      "Education",
      "Documentation",
      "Translation",
      "Editing",
    ],
  },
  Design: {
    items: ["Prototypes", "Components", "Flows", "Responsive", "Visuals"],
  },
  "Business strategy": {
    items: ["Growth", "Markets", "Campaigns", "Modeling", "Competition"],
  },
};

const selectors = {
  container: "[data-chart]",
  tooltipContainer: "[data-tooltip-container]",
  logo: "[data-logo]",
};

class MindmapDemo {
  constructor() {
    this.container = document.querySelector(selectors.container);
    this.tooltipContainer = document.querySelector(selectors.tooltipContainer);
    this.logo = document.querySelector(selectors.logo);

    this.animationDuration = 450;
    this.mobileBreakpoint = 800;

    this.strokeColor = "var(--_theme---border-tertiary)";

    this.mouse = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
    };

    this.mobileConfig = {
      maxCategories: 4,
      maxNodes: 3,
    };

    this.forceConfig = {
      charge: {
        categoryStrength: 0.3,
        itemStrength: -0.25,
      },
      collision: {
        categoryRadius: 2,
        itemRadius: 1.5,
        mobileItemRadius: 2.2,
        strength: 0.05,
        mobileStrength: 0.15,
      },
      center: {
        strength: 0.25,
      },
      radial: {
        radius: 0.9,
        mobileRadius: 0.25,
        strength: 0.001,
      },
      categoryStabilize: {
        damping: 0.75,
        resizeDamping: 0.75,
      },
      categoryRepulsion: {
        minDistance: 7.5,
        force: 0.01,
        resizeForce: 0.01,
      },
      itemRepulsion: {
        minDistance: 1.5,
        force: 0.1,
        resizeForce: 0.85,
      },
      crossCategoryRepulsion: {
        minDistance: 2.8,
        force: 0.25,
        resizeMinDistance: 2.8,
        resizeForce: 0.25,
      },
      itemToCategoryDistance: {
        minDistance: 0.5,
        maxDistance: 1.5,
        mobileMinDistance: 0.25,
        mobileMaxDistance: 1.25,
        repulsionForce: 0.04,
        attractionForce: 0.025,
        crossCategoryDistance: 2.5,
        crossCategoryForce: 0.09,
      },
      bounds: {
        marginPercent: 0.08,
        minMargin: 80,
        mobileMarginPercent: 0.15,
        mobileMinMargin: 80,
      },
      centerRepulsion: {
        logoMultiplier: 1.1,
        force: 0.25,
      },
      alpha: {
        min: 0.01,
        decay: 0.001,
        restart: 0.25,
        resizeRestart: 0.25,
      },
      resizeDamping: 0.65,
    };

    this.width = this.container.clientWidth;
    this.height = this.container.clientHeight;
    this.centerX = this.width / 2;
    this.centerY = this.height / 2;
    this.circleWidth = Math.min(40, window.innerWidth / 8);
    this.isMobile = window.innerWidth < this.mobileBreakpoint;

    this.activeTooltips = [];
    this.nodes = [];
    this.categoryGroup = null;
    this.mindmap = null;
    this.nodeGroup = null;
    this.linkGroup = null;
    this.categoryRevealIndex = 0;
    this.intervalId = null;
    this.tooltipX = 0;
    this.tooltipY = 0;
    this.showTooltip = false;
    this.tooltipContent = "";
    this.mindmap = null;
    this.simulation = null;
    this.tooltip = null;
    this.hasAnimated = false; // Track if animation has played

    this.ticked = this.ticked.bind(this);
    this.handleResize = this.handleResize.bind(this);
    this.revealNextItem = this.revealNextItem.bind(this);
    this.handleMouseMove = this.handleMouseMove.bind(this);
    this.revealNextCategory = this.revealNextCategory.bind(this);
    this.updateTooltipPosition = this.updateTooltipPosition.bind(this);

    this.init();
  }

  init() {
    this.nodes = this.createAllNodes(this.centerX, this.centerY);

    this.createMindmap();

    this.linkGroup = this.mindmap.append("g").attr("class", "links");
    this.categoryGroup = this.mindmap.append("g").attr("class", "categories");
    this.nodeGroup = this.mindmap.append("g").attr("class", "nodes");

    // Set up intersection observer instead of starting animation immediately
    this.setupIntersectionObserver();

    this.preloadTooltipImages();

    this.setupEventListeners();
  }

  preloadTooltipImages() {
    Object.values(tooltipItems).forEach((item) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.src = item.image;
      image.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    });
  }

  createMindmap() {
    this.mindmap = d3
      .select(this.container)
      .append("svg")
      .attr("width", "100%")
      .attr("height", "100%")
      .attr(
        "viewBox",
        `0 0 ${this.container.clientWidth} ${this.container.clientHeight}`
      )
      .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");

    this.nodes = this.createAllNodes(this.centerX, this.centerY);

    this.simulation = d3
      .forceSimulation(this.nodes)
      .force("charge", this.createChargeForce())
      .force("collision", this.createCollisionForce())
      .force("center", this.createCenterForce())
      .force("radial", this.createRadialForce())
      .force("categoryStabilize", this.createCategoryStabilizeForce(false))
      .force("categoryRepulsion", this.createCategoryRepulsionForce(false))
      .force("itemRepulsion", this.createItemRepulsionForce(false))
      .force(
        "crossCategoryRepulsion",
        this.createCrossCategoryRepulsionForce(false)
      )
      .force("bounds", this.createBoundsForce(false))
      .force("centerRepulsion", this.createCenterRepulsionForce())
      .on("tick", this.ticked);
  }

  createChargeForce() {
    return d3
      .forceManyBody()
      .strength((d) =>
        d.type === "category"
          ? -(this.circleWidth * this.forceConfig.charge.categoryStrength)
          : -(this.circleWidth * this.forceConfig.charge.itemStrength)
      );
  }

  createCollisionForce() {
    return d3
      .forceCollide()
      .radius((d) => {
        if (d.type === "category") {
          return this.circleWidth * this.forceConfig.collision.categoryRadius;
        } else {
          const itemRadius = this.isMobile
            ? this.forceConfig.collision.mobileItemRadius
            : this.forceConfig.collision.itemRadius;
          return this.circleWidth * itemRadius;
        }
      })
      .strength(
        this.isMobile
          ? this.forceConfig.collision.mobileStrength
          : this.forceConfig.collision.strength
      );
  }

  createCenterForce() {
    return d3
      .forceCenter(this.centerX, this.centerY)
      .strength(this.forceConfig.center.strength);
  }

  createRadialForce() {
    const radius = this.isMobile
      ? this.forceConfig.radial.mobileRadius
      : this.forceConfig.radial.radius;
    return d3
      .forceRadial(
        Math.min(this.width, this.height) * radius,
        this.centerX,
        this.centerY
      )
      .strength(this.forceConfig.radial.strength);
  }

  createCategoryStabilizeForce(isResize) {
    const damping = isResize
      ? this.forceConfig.categoryStabilize.resizeDamping
      : this.forceConfig.categoryStabilize.damping;

    return () => {
      this.nodes
        .filter((d) => d.type === "category")
        .forEach((d) => {
          if (d.vx) d.vx *= damping;
          if (d.vy) d.vy *= damping;
        });
    };
  }

  createCategoryRepulsionForce(isResize) {
    const minDistance =
      this.circleWidth * this.forceConfig.categoryRepulsion.minDistance;
    const force = isResize
      ? this.forceConfig.categoryRepulsion.resizeForce
      : this.forceConfig.categoryRepulsion.force;

    return () => {
      const categories = this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category");
      for (let i = 0; i < categories.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < categories.length; j++) {
          const a = categories[i];
          const b = categories[j];
          const dx = b.x - a.x;
          const dy = b.y - a.y;
          const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

          if (distance < minDistance && distance > 0) {
            const forceValue = (minDistance - distance) * force;
            const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
            const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

            a.vx = (a.vx || 0) - fx;
            a.vy = (a.vy || 0) - fy;
            b.vx = (b.vx || 0) + fx;
            b.vy = (b.vy || 0) + fy;
          }
        }
      }
    };
  }

  createItemRepulsionForce(isResize) {
    const minDistance =
      this.circleWidth * this.forceConfig.itemRepulsion.minDistance;
    const force = isResize
      ? this.forceConfig.itemRepulsion.resizeForce
      : this.forceConfig.itemRepulsion.force;

    return () => {
      const items = this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item");
      const categories = this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category");

      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < items.length; j++) {
          const a = items[i];
          const b = items[j];
          const dx = b.x - a.x;
          const dy = b.y - a.y;
          const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

          if (distance < minDistance && distance > 0) {
            const forceValue = (minDistance - distance) * force;
            const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
            const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

            a.vx = (a.vx || 0) - fx;
            a.vy = (a.vy || 0) - fy;
            b.vx = (b.vx || 0) + fx;
            b.vy = (b.vy || 0) + fy;
          }
        }
      }

      if (isResize) {
        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
          for (let j = 0; j < categories.length; j++) {
            const item = items[i];
            const category = categories[j];

            const dx = item.x - category.x;
            const dy = item.y - category.y;
            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

            if (item.category === category.name) {
              const minDistance =
                this.circleWidth *
                (this.isMobile
                  ? this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.mobileMinDistance
                  : this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.minDistance);
              const maxDistance =
                this.circleWidth *
                (this.isMobile
                  ? this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.mobileMaxDistance
                  : this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.maxDistance);

              if (distance < minDistance && distance > 0) {
                const forceValue =
                  (minDistance - distance) *
                  this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.repulsionForce;
                const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
                const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

                item.vx = (item.vx || 0) + fx;
                item.vy = (item.vy || 0) + fy;
              } else if (distance > maxDistance) {
                const forceValue =
                  (distance - maxDistance) *
                  this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.attractionForce;
                const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
                const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

                item.vx = (item.vx || 0) - fx;
                item.vy = (item.vy || 0) - fy;
              }
            } else {
              const crossCategoryDistance =
                this.circleWidth *
                this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.crossCategoryDistance;
              if (distance < crossCategoryDistance && distance > 0) {
                const forceValue =
                  (crossCategoryDistance - distance) *
                  this.forceConfig.itemToCategoryDistance.crossCategoryForce;
                const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
                const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

                item.vx = (item.vx || 0) + fx;
                item.vy = (item.vy || 0) + fy;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };
  }

  createCrossCategoryRepulsionForce(isResize) {
    const minDistance =
      this.circleWidth *
      (isResize
        ? this.forceConfig.crossCategoryRepulsion.resizeMinDistance
        : this.forceConfig.crossCategoryRepulsion.minDistance);
    const force = isResize
      ? this.forceConfig.crossCategoryRepulsion.resizeForce
      : this.forceConfig.crossCategoryRepulsion.force;

    return () => {
      const items = this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item");
      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < items.length; j++) {
          const a = items[i];
          const b = items[j];

          if (a.category !== b.category) {
            const dx = b.x - a.x;
            const dy = b.y - a.y;
            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

            if (distance < minDistance && distance > 0) {
              const forceValue = (minDistance - distance) * force;
              const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
              const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

              a.vx = (a.vx || 0) - fx;
              a.vy = (a.vy || 0) - fy;
              b.vx = (b.vx || 0) + fx;
              b.vy = (b.vy || 0) + fy;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };
  }

  createBoundsForce(isResize) {
    return () => {
      const marginPercent = this.isMobile
        ? this.forceConfig.bounds.mobileMarginPercent
        : this.forceConfig.bounds.marginPercent;
      const minMargin = this.isMobile
        ? this.forceConfig.bounds.mobileMinMargin
        : this.forceConfig.bounds.minMargin;

      const margin = Math.min(this.width, this.height) * marginPercent;
      const actualMargin = Math.max(margin, minMargin);

      this.nodes.forEach((node) => {
        node.x = Math.max(
          actualMargin,
          Math.min(this.width - actualMargin, node.x)
        );
        node.y = Math.max(
          actualMargin,
          Math.min(this.height - actualMargin, node.y)
        );
      });
    };
  }

  createCenterRepulsionForce() {
    return () => {
      const centerX = this.width / 2;
      const centerY = this.height / 2;
      const logoRadius = Math.max(
        this.logo.clientWidth * this.forceConfig.centerRepulsion.logoMultiplier,
        this.logo.clientHeight * this.forceConfig.centerRepulsion.logoMultiplier
      );

      this.nodes.forEach((node) => {
        const dx = node.x - centerX;
        const dy = node.y - centerY;
        const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        if (distance < logoRadius && distance > 0) {
          const forceValue =
            (logoRadius - distance) * this.forceConfig.centerRepulsion.force;
          const fx = (dx / distance) * forceValue;
          const fy = (dy / distance) * forceValue;

          node.vx = (node.vx || 0) + fx;
          node.vy = (node.vy || 0) + fy;
        }
      });
    };
  }

  updateSimulation() {
    this.simulation.force(
      "center",
      d3.forceCenter(this.centerX, this.centerY).strength(0.005)
    );
    this.simulation.force("radial", this.createRadialForce());
    this.simulation.force(
      "categoryStabilize",
      this.createCategoryStabilizeForce(true)
    );
    this.simulation.force(
      "categoryRepulsion",
      this.createCategoryRepulsionForce(true)
    );
    this.simulation.force("itemRepulsion", this.createItemRepulsionForce(true));
    this.simulation.force(
      "crossCategoryRepulsion",
      this.createCrossCategoryRepulsionForce(true)
    );
    this.simulation.force("bounds", this.createBoundsForce(true));
    this.simulation.force("centerRepulsion", this.createCenterRepulsionForce());

    this.simulation.force("resizeDamping", () => {
      this.nodes.forEach((d) => {
        const type = d.type;
        const multiplier = type === "category" ? 1 : 0.75;
        if (d.vx) d.vx *= this.forceConfig.resizeDamping * multiplier;
        if (d.vy) d.vy *= this.forceConfig.resizeDamping * multiplier;
      });
    });

    this.simulation
      .alphaMin(this.forceConfig.alpha.min)
      .alphaDecay(this.forceConfig.alpha.decay)
      .alpha(this.forceConfig.alpha.resizeRestart)
      .restart();
  }

  createAllNodes(centerX, centerY) {
    const allNodes = [];
    const categoryNames = Object.keys(categories);

    categoryNames.forEach((categoryName, categoryIndex) => {
      const categorySize = Math.min(
        categoryNames.length,
        this.isMobile ? this.mobileConfig.maxCategories : categoryNames.length
      );

      let angle, baseRadius, radius;
      if (this.isMobile) {
        // For mobile, distribute more vertically by adjusting angle calculation
        const verticalBias = 0.7; // Bias towards vertical distribution
        const horizontalSpread = 0.3; // Reduce horizontal spread
        angle =
          (categoryIndex / categorySize) * Math.PI * 2 * verticalBias +
          Math.PI * horizontalSpread * (categoryIndex % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1) +
          (Math.random() * 0.05 - 0.025);
        baseRadius = Math.min(this.width, this.height) * 0.2;
        radius = baseRadius + (Math.random() - 0.5) * baseRadius * 0.05;
      } else {
        angle =
          (categoryIndex / categorySize + (Math.random() * 0.1 - 0.05)) *
          (Math.PI * 2);
        baseRadius = Math.min(this.width, this.height) * 0.25;
        radius = baseRadius + (Math.random() - 0.5) * baseRadius * 0.1;
      }

      const categoryNode = {
        id: `category-${categoryIndex}`,
        name: categoryName,
        type: "category",
        categoryColor: "#FF6B35",
        y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
        x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        visible: false,
      };

      allNodes.push(categoryNode);

      const categoryData = categories[categoryName];

      categoryData.items.forEach((itemName, itemIndex) => {
        const categoryNodeSize = Math.min(
          categoryData.items.length,
          this.isMobile ? this.mobileConfig.maxNodes : categoryData.items.length
        );
        const itemAngle =
          (itemIndex / categoryData.items.length) * (Math.PI * 2);

        const baseItemRadius = this.isMobile ? 1.8 : 2.8;
        const itemRadius =
          this.circleWidth * baseItemRadius +
          Math.random() * (this.circleWidth * 0.05);

        const itemNode = {
          id: `item-${categoryName}-${itemIndex}`,
          name: itemName,
          type: "item",
          category: categoryName,
          categoryColor: "#FF6B35",
          x: categoryNode.x + Math.cos(itemAngle) * itemRadius,
          y: categoryNode.y + Math.sin(itemAngle) * itemRadius,
          visible: false,
        };

        allNodes.push(itemNode);
      });
    });

    return allNodes;
  }

  getActiveCategoryNames() {
    const categoryNames = Object.keys(categories);

    if (this.isMobile) {
      return categoryNames.filter(
        (_, index) => index < this.mobileConfig.maxCategories
      );
    }

    return categoryNames;
  }

  updateCategoryVisibilityForScreenSize() {
    const activeCategoryNames = this.getActiveCategoryNames();

    // Remove all DOM elements for categories/items/links that are no longer visible
    this.categoryGroup
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(
        this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible),
        (d) => d.id
      )
      .exit()
      .remove();
    this.categoryGroup
      .selectAll("text")
      .data(
        this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible),
        (d) => d.id
      )
      .exit()
      .remove();
    this.nodeGroup
      .selectAll(".item-circle")
      .data(
        this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
        (d) => d.id
      )
      .exit()
      .remove();
    this.nodeGroup
      .selectAll(".item-label-group")
      .data(
        this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
        (d) => d.id
      )
      .exit()
      .remove();
    this.linkGroup
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(
        this.nodes.filter((d) => d.visible),
        (d) => d.id
      )
      .exit()
      .remove();

    // Update node visibility state
    this.nodes.forEach((node) => {
      if (node.type === "category") {
        const shouldBeVisible = activeCategoryNames.includes(node.name);
        if (!shouldBeVisible && node.visible) {
          node.visible = false;
          this.nodes
            .filter((n) => n.type === "item" && n.category === node.name)
            .forEach((item) => (item.visible = false));
        } else if (shouldBeVisible && !node.visible) {
          node.visible = true;
          this.nodes.forEach((n) => {
            if (n.type === "item" && n.category === node.name) n.visible = true;
          });
        }
      }

      if (node.type === "item") {
        const category = categories[node.category];
        const index = category.items.indexOf(node.name);
        if (
          (this.isMobile && index >= this.mobileConfig.maxNodes) ||
          !activeCategoryNames.includes(node.category)
        ) {
          node.visible = false;
        } else {
          node.visible = true;
        }
      }
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      this.categoryGroup
        .selectAll("circle")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("circle")
        .attr("r", this.circleWidth * 0.8)
        .attr("cx", (d) => d.x)
        .attr("cy", (d) => d.y)
        .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---background-primary)")
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9);

      this.categoryGroup
        .selectAll("text")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("text")
        .text((d) => d.name)
        .attr("x", (d) => d.x)
        .attr("y", (d) => d.y + 5)
        .attr("font-weight", "600")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---foreground-primary)")
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", 1);

      this.nodeGroup
        .selectAll(".item-circle")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("circle")
        .attr("class", "item-circle")
        .attr("r", this.circleWidth * 0.45)
        .attr("cx", (d) => d.x)
        .attr("cy", (d) => d.y)
        .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---background-primary)")
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", 1);

      // Use a group for each label, so we can have <a> or <text> inside, and always have a stable selection
      const labelGroups = this.nodeGroup
        .selectAll(".item-label-group")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("g")
        .attr("class", "item-label-group")
        .attr("pointer-events", "all")
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", 1);

      labelGroups.each(function (d) {
        d3.select(this).selectAll("*").remove();
        if (tooltipItems[d.name]) {
          // Use <a> for clickable items
          const a = d3
            .select(this)
            .append("a")
            .attr("xlink:href", tooltipItems[d.name].url)
            .attr("target", "_blank")
            .attr("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
          a.append("text")
            .text(d.name)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("x", d.x)
            .attr("y", d.y + 3)
            .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---foreground-tertiary)")
            .attr("class", "tooltip-item")
            .style("cursor", "pointer")
            .style("text-decoration", "underline")
            .style("text-decoration-color", "rgba(156, 154, 146, 0.4)")
            .style("text-underline-offset", "4px")
            .style("text-decoration-thickness", "0.5px");
        } else {
          d3.select(this)
            .append("text")
            .text(d.name)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("x", d.x)
            .attr("y", d.y + 3)
            .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---foreground-tertiary)")
            .attr("class", "")
            .style("cursor", "default")
            .style("text-decoration", "none")
            .style("text-decoration-color", "none")
            .style("text-underline-offset", "4px")
            .style("text-decoration-thickness", "0.5px");
        }
      });

      // Attach tooltip events to the group, not the <text> or <a>
      this.nodeGroup
        .selectAll(".item-label-group")
        .on("mouseenter", (event, d) => {
          if (tooltipItems[d.name]) {
            this.createTooltip(d.name, event);
          }
        })
        .on("mouseleave", (event, d) => {
          this.destroyTooltip(d.name);
        });

      this.linkGroup
        .selectAll("line")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("line")
        .attr("stroke", this.strokeColor)
        .attr("stroke-width", 1)
        .attr("x1", (d) => {
          if (d.type === "category") return this.width / 2;
          const cat = this.nodes.find(
            (n) => n.type === "category" && n.name === d.category
          );
          return cat ? cat.x : this.width / 2;
        })
        .attr("y1", (d) => {
          if (d.type === "category") return this.height / 2;
          const cat = this.nodes.find(
            (n) => n.type === "category" && n.name === d.category
          );
          return cat ? cat.y : this.height / 2;
        })
        .attr("x2", (d) => d.x)
        .attr("y2", (d) => d.y)
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", (d) => (d.type === "category" ? 0.6 : 0.4));
    }, 50);
  }

  ticked() {
    const visibleNodes = this.nodes.filter((d) => d.visible);

    const linkElements = this.linkGroup.selectAll("line").data(visibleNodes);

    linkElements
      .attr("x1", (d) => {
        if (d.type === "category") return this.centerX;
        // For items, connect to their category
        const category = this.nodes.find(
          (n) => n.type === "category" && n.name === d.category
        );

        return category ? category.x : this.centerX;
      })
      .attr("y1", (d) => {
        if (d.type === "category") return this.centerY;
        const category = this.nodes.find(
          (n) => n.type === "category" && n.name === d.category
        );
        return category ? category.y : this.centerY;
      })
      .attr("x2", (d) => d.x)
      .attr("y2", (d) => d.y);

    // Render category nodes (only visible ones)
    const categoryCircles = this.categoryGroup.selectAll("circle").data(
      this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible),
      (d) => d.id
    );

    categoryCircles.attr("cx", (d) => d.x).attr("cy", (d) => d.y);

    // Render category labels (only visible ones)
    const categoryLabels = this.categoryGroup.selectAll("text").data(
      this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible),
      (d) => d.id
    );

    categoryLabels.attr("x", (d) => d.x).attr("y", (d) => d.y + 5);

    // Render item nodes (only visible ones)
    const itemCircles = this.nodeGroup.selectAll(".item-circle").data(
      this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
      (d) => d.id
    );

    itemCircles.attr("cx", (d) => d.x).attr("cy", (d) => d.y);

    // Render item labels (only visible ones)
    const itemLabelGroups = this.nodeGroup.selectAll(".item-label-group").data(
      this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
      (d) => d.id
    );
    itemLabelGroups.attr("transform", (d) => `translate(0,0)`);
    // Update the <text> or <a> inside the group
    itemLabelGroups.each(function (d) {
      // Update position of <text> or <a><text>
      if (tooltipItems[d.name]) {
        d3.select(this)
          .select("a text")
          .attr("x", d.x)
          .attr("y", d.y + 3);
      } else {
        d3.select(this)
          .select("text")
          .attr("x", d.x)
          .attr("y", d.y + 3);
      }
    });
  }

  positionTooltipElement(tooltip) {
    if (!tooltip) return;

    const tooltipWidth = tooltip.offsetWidth || 260;
    const tooltipHeight = tooltip.offsetHeight || 180;

    const offsetY = 20;

    const left =
      this.mouse.x > window.innerWidth / 2
        ? this.mouse.x - (tooltipWidth - 8)
        : this.mouse.x - 8;
    const top =
      this.mouse.y < window.innerHeight / 2
        ? this.mouse.y + offsetY
        : this.mouse.y - tooltipHeight - offsetY;

    tooltip.style.left = `${left}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${top}px`;
    tooltip.style.transform = "translate(0,0)";
  }

  updateTooltipPosition(name) {
    const tooltip = document.getElementById(`tooltip-${name.toLowerCase()}`);
    this.positionTooltipElement(tooltip);
  }

  createTooltip(name) {
    if (this.activeTooltips.includes(name)) {
      const existingTooltip = document.getElementById(
        `tooltip-${name.toLowerCase()}`
      );
      this.updateTooltipPosition(name);
      gsap.to(existingTooltip, {
        opacity: 1,
        scale: 1,
        duration: 0.65,
        ease: "expo.out",
        overwrite: true,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.activeTooltips = [...this.activeTooltips, name];

    const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
    const tooltipHeading = document.createElement("h3");
    const tooltipImage = document.createElement("img");
    const tooltipBody = document.createElement("p");

    const originX = this.mouse.x < window.innerWidth / 2 ? "left" : "right";
    const originY = this.mouse.y < window.innerHeight / 2 ? "top" : "bottom";

    tooltip.style.transformOrigin = `${originY} ${originX}`;

    tooltip.id = `tooltip-${name.toLowerCase()}`;
    tooltip.classList.add("mindmap__tooltip");

    tooltipHeading.textContent = tooltipItems[name].heading;
    tooltipHeading.classList.add("mindmap__tooltip-heading");

    tooltipImage.classList.add("mindmap__tooltip-image");
    tooltipImage.src = tooltipItems[name].image;
    tooltipImage.crossOrigin = "anonymous";

    tooltipBody.classList.add("mindmap__tooltip-body");
    tooltipBody.textContent = tooltipItems[name].body;

    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipHeading);
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipImage);
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipBody);

    document.body.appendChild(tooltip);

    this.positionTooltipElement(tooltip);

    gsap.set(tooltip, { opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 });

    setTimeout(() => {
      gsap.to(tooltip, {
        opacity: 1,
        scale: 1,
        duration: 0.65,
        ease: "expo.out",
        overwrite: true,
      });
    }, 10);
  }

  destroyTooltip(name) {
    const tooltips = document.querySelectorAll(".mindmap__tooltip");
    gsap.to(tooltips, {
      opacity: 0,
      scale: 0.95,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: "expo.out",
      overwrite: true,
      onComplete: () => {
        this.activeTooltips = this.activeTooltips.filter(
          (tooltip) => tooltip !== name
        );
        tooltips?.forEach((tooltip) => tooltip.remove());
      },
    });
  }

  revealNextCategory() {
    const categoryNames = this.getActiveCategoryNames();

    if (this.categoryRevealIndex >= categoryNames.length) {
      // All categories revealed, start revealing items
      clearInterval(this.intervalId);
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.intervalId = setInterval(this.revealNextItem, 100);
      }, 200);
      return;
    }

    const categoryName = categoryNames[this.categoryRevealIndex];
    const categoryNode = this.nodes.find(
      (n) => n.name === categoryName && n.type === "category"
    );

    if (categoryNode) {
      categoryNode.visible = true;

      // Animate the reveal
      setTimeout(() => {
        const categoryElements = this.categoryGroup
          .selectAll("circle")
          .data(this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible));
        const labelElements = this.categoryGroup
          .selectAll("text")
          .data(this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "category" && d.visible));
        const linkElements = this.linkGroup
          .selectAll("line")
          .data(this.nodes.filter((d) => d.visible));

        categoryElements
          .enter()
          .append("circle")
          .attr("r", this.circleWidth * 0.8)
          .attr("cx", (d) => d.x)
          .attr("cy", (d) => d.y)
          .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---background-primary)")
          .attr("opacity", 0)
          .transition()
          .duration(this.animationDuration)
          .attr("opacity", 0.9);

        labelElements
          .enter()
          .append("text")
          .text((d) => d.name)
          .attr("font-weight", "600")
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("x", (d) => d.x)
          .attr("y", (d) => d.y + 5)
          .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---foreground-primary)")
          .attr("opacity", 0)
          .transition()
          .duration(this.animationDuration)
          .attr("opacity", 1);

        linkElements
          .enter()
          .append("line")
          .attr("stroke", this.strokeColor)
          .attr("stroke-width", 1)
          .attr("x1", this.width / 2)
          .attr("y1", this.height / 2)
          .attr("x2", (d) => d.x)
          .attr("y2", (d) => d.y)
          .attr("opacity", 0)
          .transition()
          .duration(this.animationDuration)
          .attr("opacity", 0.6);
      }, 20);
    }

    this.categoryRevealIndex++;
  }

  revealNextItem() {
    const activeCategoryNames = this.getActiveCategoryNames();
    const hiddenItems = this.nodes.filter(
      (n) =>
        n.type === "item" &&
        !n.visible &&
        activeCategoryNames.includes(n.category)
    );

    if (hiddenItems.length === 0) {
      clearInterval(this.intervalId);
      return;
    }

    const nextItem = hiddenItems[0];
    nextItem.visible = true;

    // Animate the reveal
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.nodeGroup
        .selectAll(".item-circle")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("circle")
        .attr("class", "item-circle")
        .attr("r", this.circleWidth * 0.5)
        .attr("cx", (d) => d.x)
        .attr("cy", (d) => d.y)
        .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---background-primary)")
        .attr("stroke-width", 0)
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", 0.8);

      // Use a group for each label, so we can have <a> or <text> inside, and always have a stable selection
      const labelGroups = this.nodeGroup
        .selectAll(".item-label-group")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.type === "item" && d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("g")
        .attr("class", "item-label-group")
        .attr("pointer-events", "all")
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", 1);

      labelGroups.each(function (d) {
        d3.select(this).selectAll("*").remove();
        if (tooltipItems[d.name]) {
          // Use <a> for clickable items
          const a = d3
            .select(this)
            .append("a")
            .attr("xlink:href", tooltipItems[d.name].url)
            .attr("target", "_blank")
            .attr("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
          a.append("text")
            .text(d.name)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("x", d.x)
            .attr("y", d.y + 3)
            .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---foreground-tertiary)")
            .attr("class", "tooltip-item")
            .style("cursor", "pointer")
            .style("text-decoration", "underline")
            .style("text-decoration-color", "rgba(156, 154, 146, 0.4)")
            .style("text-underline-offset", "4px")
            .style("text-decoration-thickness", "0.5px");
        } else {
          d3.select(this)
            .append("text")
            .text(d.name)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("x", d.x)
            .attr("y", d.y + 3)
            .attr("fill", "var(--_theme---foreground-tertiary)")
            .attr("class", "")
            .style("cursor", "default")
            .style("text-decoration", "none")
            .style("text-decoration-color", "none")
            .style("text-underline-offset", "4px")
            .style("text-decoration-thickness", "0.5px");
        }
      });

      // Attach tooltip events to the group, not the <text> or <a>
      this.nodeGroup
        .selectAll(".item-label-group a")
        .on("mouseenter", (event, d) => {
          if (tooltipItems[d.name]) {
            this.createTooltip(d.name, event);
          }
        })
        .on("mouseleave", (event, d) => {
          this.destroyTooltip(d.name);
        });

      this.linkGroup
        .selectAll("line")
        .data(
          this.nodes.filter((d) => d.visible),
          (d) => d.id
        )
        .enter()
        .append("line")
        .attr("stroke", this.strokeColor)
        .attr("stroke-width", 1)
        .attr("x1", (d) => {
          if (d.type === "category") return this.centerX;
          const category = this.nodes.find(
            (n) => n.type === "category" && n.name === d.category
          );
          return category ? category.x : this.centerX;
        })
        .attr("y1", (d) => {
          if (d.type === "category") return this.centerY;
          const category = this.nodes.find(
            (n) => n.type === "category" && n.name === d.category
          );
          return category ? category.y : this.centerY;
        })
        .attr("x2", (d) => d.x)
        .attr("y2", (d) => d.y)
        .attr("opacity", 0)
        .transition()
        .duration(this.animationDuration)
        .attr("opacity", (d) => (d.type === "category" ? 0.6 : 0.4));
    }, 20);

    this.simulation.alpha(0.2).restart();
  }

  handleMouseMove(event) {
    this.mouse.x = event.clientX;
    this.mouse.y = event.clientY;

    this.activeTooltips.forEach((tooltip) => {
      this.updateTooltipPosition(tooltip);
    });
  }

  handleResize() {
    this.width = this.container.clientWidth;
    this.height = this.container.clientHeight;
    this.centerX = this.width / 2;
    this.centerY = this.height / 2;
    this.circleWidth = Math.min(40, window.innerWidth / 8);
    this.isMobile = window.innerWidth < this.mobileBreakpoint;

    this.mindmap.attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${this.width} ${this.height}`);

    this.updateSimulation();

    this.updateCategoryVisibilityForScreenSize();
  }

  setupIntersectionObserver() {
    // Create intersection observer to trigger animation when mindmap comes into view
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !this.hasAnimated) {
            this.startAnimation();
            this.hasAnimated = true;
            // Disconnect observer after first trigger
            observer.disconnect();
          }
        });
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.2, // Trigger when 20% of the mindmap is visible
        rootMargin: "0px 0px -50px 0px", // Start animation slightly before fully in view
      }
    );

    // Observe the mindmap container
    observer.observe(this.container);
  }

  startAnimation() {
    // Start revealing categories
    this.intervalId = setInterval(this.revealNextCategory, 100);
  }

  setupEventListeners() {
    window.addEventListener("resize", this.handleResize);
    window.addEventListener("mousemove", this.handleMouseMove);
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  new MindmapDemo();
});
</script></div></div></div></div><div data-wf--module-cta-simple--theme="base" class="cta_simple_wrap u-theme-white"><div class="cta_simple_content"><div><div class="cta_simple_text u-text-style-h5">Switching to Claude from another AI provider? <br>Import your memory and pick up where you left off.</div><p class="cta_simple_subtext u-mt-text u-foreground-tertiary u-text-style-body-2 u-text-wrap-balance">You can configure Claude Code to work with third party API keys.&nbsp;</p></div></div><div data-wf--button-wrapper--mobile-styling="full-width-mobile" id="" class="u-display-contents"><div class="u-button-group w-variant-92fe68b6-7437-d0c6-3fc0-cc8114f8d03d u-mt-0 u-flex-noshrink"><div class="u-display-contents"><div data-wf--button-main--style="primary" class="button_main_wrap"><div class="u-embed-css w-embed"><style>
