</style></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="button_main_text u-text-style-body-2">Start importing</div><div class="clickable_wrap u-cover-absolute"><a data-cta-copy="Start importaing" target="" data-cta="Overview page" data-cta-position="The AI for problem solvers section" href="/import-memory" data-wf-event-ids="157059830" class="clickable_link w-inline-block"><span class="clickable_text u-sr-only">Start importing</span></a><button type="button" class="clickable_btn"><span class="clickable_text u-sr-only">Start importing</span></button></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-wf--spacer--section-space="main" class="u-section-spacer w-variant-60a7ad7d-02b0-6682-95a5-2218e6fd1490 u-ignore-trim"></div></section><section data-wf--section--theme="white" class="u-section w-variant-a4eabb01-8ed6-63d0-157e-0a7b56aedaa1" id="" style="translate: none; rotate: none; scale: none; transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;"><div class="u-section-divider"></div><div data-wf--spacer--section-space="main" class="u-section-spacer w-variant-60a7ad7d-02b0-6682-95a5-2218e6fd1490 u-ignore-trim"></div><div class="section_contain u-container u-margin-trim"><div data-animate-header-wrap="" data-wf--module-header-main--heading-style="h1" class="header_main_wrap u-margin-trim u-alignment-center"><div class="u-pictogram-wrap"><div class="header_icon"><div data-lottie-loop="true" data-lottie-component="" data-lottie-src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6889473510b50328dbb70ae6/68c2c5f0d67e39645f94ee03_Hand-Bolt.lottie" class="pictogram_lottie_wrap" data-script-initialized="true"><div data-lottie-host="" class="pictogram_lottie"><dotlottie-player src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6889473510b50328dbb70ae6/68c2c5f0d67e39645f94ee03_Hand-Bolt.lottie" renderer="svg" autoplay="false" loop="true" style="width: 100%; height: 100%;"></dotlottie-player></div><div class="u-embed-js w-embed w-script"><script>
  (function() {
    "use strict";

    /* ===================== Prevent double initialization ===================== */
    if (window.__pictogramLottieInitialized) return;
    window.__pictogramLottieInitialized = true;

    /* ===================== CONFIG ===================== */
    const COLOR_MAP = {
      fills: [
        { from: ["#131314", "rgb(19,19,20)", "rgb(19, 19, 20)", "#141413", "rgb(20,20,19)", "rgb(20, 20, 19)"],
         to: "var(--_theme---foreground-primary)" },
        { from: ["#DEDCD1", "rgb(222,220,209)", "rgb(222,220,209)", "#e3dacc", "rgb(227,218,204)", "rgb(227, 218, 204)"],
         to: "var(--_theme---pictogram-accent)" }
      ],
      strokes: [
        { from: ["#ff0000", "rgb(255,0,0)", "rgb(255, 0, 0)"],
         to: "var(--_theme---pictogram-accent)" }
      ]
    };

    const FORCE_MODE = true;
    const RECOLOR_FRAME_INTERVAL = 2;
    const LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL = 100;
    const LOTTIE_MAX_RETRIES = 50;

    /* ===================== Helpers ===================== */
    const normHex = (hex) => {
      const h = String(hex || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!h) return null;
      let v = h.startsWith("#") ? h.slice(1) : h;
      if (v.length === 3) v = v.split("").map(c => c + c).join("");
      if (v.length === 6) return "#" + v;
      if (v.length === 8) return "#" + v.slice(0, 6);
      return null;
    };

    const toHex2 = (n) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(n))).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");

    const normRgb = (rgb) => {
      const m = String(rgb || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").match(/^rgba?\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)(?:,([\d.]+))?\)$/i);
      if (!m) return null;
      return "#" + toHex2(+m[1]) + toHex2(+m[2]) + toHex2(+m[3]);
    };

    const normColor = (c) => {
      if (!c || /^none$/i.test(c)) return null;
      if (/^var\(/i.test(c)) return null;
      return normHex(c) || normRgb(c);
    };

    function buildPairs() {
      const fills = [];
      const strokes = [];
      COLOR_MAP.fills.forEach(({ from, to }) => {
        (Array.isArray(from) ? from : [from]).forEach(f => {
          const k = normColor(f);
          if (k) {
            const [r, g, b] = [k.slice(1, 3), k.slice(3, 5), k.slice(5, 7)].map(v => parseInt(v, 16));
            fills.push({ hex: k, rgbLoose: new RegExp(`rgb\\s*\\(\\s*${r}\\s*,\\s*${g}\\s*,\\s*${b}\\s*\\)`, "gi"), to });
          }
        });
      });
      COLOR_MAP.strokes.forEach(({ from, to }) => {
        (Array.isArray(from) ? from : [from]).forEach(f => {
          const k = normColor(f);
          if (k) {
            const [r, g, b] = [k.slice(1, 3), k.slice(3, 5), k.slice(5, 7)].map(v => parseInt(v, 16));
            strokes.push({ hex: k, rgbLoose: new RegExp(`rgb\\s*\\(\\s*${r}\\s*,\\s*${g}\\s*,\\s*${b}\\s*\\)`, "gi"), to });
          }
        });
      });
      return { fills, strokes };
    }

    function recolorSvg(svgRoot, pairs) {
      if (!svgRoot) return;
      const maybeSwap = (val, list) => {
        const n = normColor(val);
        if (!n) return null;
        const hit = list.find(p => p.hex === n);
        return hit ? hit.to : null;
      };

      svgRoot.querySelectorAll("path, rect, circle, ellipse, polygon, polyline, line, g, use").forEach(el => {
        const fAttr = el.getAttribute("fill");
        const fStyle = el.style && el.style.fill ? el.style.fill : null;
        const fTo = maybeSwap(fAttr, pairs.fills) || maybeSwap(fStyle, pairs.fills);
        if (fTo) { el.setAttribute("fill", fTo); if (el.style) el.style.fill = fTo; }

        const sAttr = el.getAttribute("stroke");
        const sStyle = el.style && el.style.stroke ? el.style.stroke : null;
        const sTo = maybeSwap(sAttr, pairs.strokes) || maybeSwap(sStyle, pairs.strokes);
        if (sTo) { el.setAttribute("stroke", sTo); if (el.style) el.style.stroke = sTo; }
      });

      svgRoot.querySelectorAll("stop").forEach(stop => {
        const scAttr = stop.getAttribute("stop-color");
        const scStyle = stop.style && stop.style.stopColor ? stop.style.stopColor : null;
        const fTo = maybeSwap(scAttr, pairs.fills) || maybeSwap(scStyle, pairs.fills);
        if (fTo) { stop.setAttribute("stop-color", fTo); if (stop.style) stop.style.stopColor = fTo; }
      });

      svgRoot.querySelectorAll("style").forEach(s => {
        const before = s.textContent || "";
        let css = before;
        pairs.fills.forEach(({ hex, rgbLoose, to }) => {
          css = css.replace(new RegExp(hex.replace('#', '\\#'), "gi"), to);
          css = css.replace(rgbLoose, to);
        });
        pairs.strokes.forEach(({ hex, rgbLoose, to }) => {
          css = css.replace(new RegExp(hex.replace('#', '\\#'), "gi"), to);
          css = css.replace(rgbLoose, to);
        });
        if (css !== before) s.textContent = css;
      });
    }

    /* ===================== Build color pairs once ===================== */
    const pairs = buildPairs();

    /* ===================== Reactive reduced motion preference ===================== */
    const reducedMotionQuery = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    let prefersReducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;

    const onReducedMotionChange = (e) => {
      prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
      if (prefersReducedMotion) {
        elementDataMap.forEach((data) => {
          if (data.api && data.api.isReady) data.api.pause();
        });
      } else {
        checkAllVisibleElements();
      }
    };

    if (reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener) {
      reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener("change", onReducedMotionChange);
    } else if (reducedMotionQuery.addListener) {
      reducedMotionQuery.addListener(onReducedMotionChange);
    }

    /* ===================== Element tracking ===================== */
    const elementDataMap = new Map();
    const pendingElements = new Set();

    /* ===================== Single RAF loop for all recoloring ===================== */
    let rafId = null;
    let frameCount = 0;

    function recolorLoop() {
      frameCount++;
      if (frameCount % RECOLOR_FRAME_INTERVAL === 0) {
        elementDataMap.forEach((data, root) => {
          if (root.isConnected && data.isVisible && data.svgRoot) {
            recolorSvg(data.svgRoot, pairs);
          }
        });
      }
      if (FORCE_MODE && elementDataMap.size > 0) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(recolorLoop);
      } else {
        rafId = null;
      }
    }

    function startRecolorLoop() {
      if (FORCE_MODE && rafId === null && elementDataMap.size > 0) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(recolorLoop);
      }
    }

    function stopRecolorLoopIfEmpty() {
      if (elementDataMap.size === 0 && rafId !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        rafId = null;
      }
    }

    /* ===================== Lottie library retry mechanism ===================== */
    let retryTimeoutId = null;
    let retryCount = 0;

    function isLottieAvailable() {
      return window.lottie && typeof window.lottie.loadAnimation === "function";
    }

    function processPendingElements() {
      if (pendingElements.size === 0) {
        retryTimeoutId = null;
        retryCount = 0;
        return;
      }

      if (isLottieAvailable()) {
        pendingElements.forEach(root => {
          if (root.isConnected) {
            delete root.dataset.scriptInitialized;
            initLottieElement(root);
          }
        });
        pendingElements.clear();
        retryTimeoutId = null;
        retryCount = 0;
        return;
      }

      retryCount++;
      if (retryCount >= LOTTIE_MAX_RETRIES) {
        console.warn("Pictogram Lottie: lottie-web library not available after " + (LOTTIE_MAX_RETRIES * LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL / 1000) + "s timeout");
        pendingElements.clear();
        retryTimeoutId = null;
        retryCount = 0;
        return;
      }

      retryTimeoutId = setTimeout(processPendingElements, LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL);
    }

    function queueForLottieRetry(root) {
      pendingElements.add(root);
      if (retryTimeoutId === null) {
        retryTimeoutId = setTimeout(processPendingElements, LOTTIE_RETRY_INTERVAL);
      }
    }

    /* ===================== Per-element initialization ===================== */
    function initLottieElement(root) {
      if (root.dataset.scriptInitialized === "true" && !elementDataMap.has(root)) {
        delete root.dataset.scriptInitialized;
      }

      if (root.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
      root.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

      const OBS_ROOT_MARGIN = root.getAttribute("data-lottie-rootmargin") || "0px 0px -10% 0px";
      const OBS_THRESHOLD = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Number(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-threshold") || 0.2)));

      const src = root.getAttribute("data-lottie-src");
      if (!src) return;

      const loop = !/^(false|0|no)$/i.test(String(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-loop") || "true"));
      const rawSpeed = Number(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-speed") || 1);
      const speed = (rawSpeed > 0) ? rawSpeed : 1;
      const direction = Number(root.getAttribute("data-lottie-direction") || 1) === -1 ? -1 : 1;

      let host = root.querySelector("[data-lottie-host]");
      if (!host) {
        host = document.createElement("div");
        host.setAttribute("data-lottie-host", "");
        host.style.width = "100%";
        host.style.height = "100%";
        root.appendChild(host);
      }

      const isDotLottie = /\.lottie(\?|#|$)/i.test(src);
      const hasDot = typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !!customElements.get("dotlottie-player");

      if (!isDotLottie || !hasDot) {
        if (!isLottieAvailable()) {
          queueForLottieRetry(root);
          return;
        }
      }

      const data = {
        api: null,
        io: null,
        svgRoot: null,
        isVisible: false,
        anim: null,
        checkAndPlayIfVisible: null
      };

      function isElementInViewport() {
        const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
        const windowHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        const windowWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
        return (rect.top < windowHeight && rect.bottom > 0) && (rect.left < windowWidth && rect.right > 0);
      }

      function checkAndPlayIfVisible() {
        if (!data.api || !data.api.isReady) return;
        if (prefersReducedMotion) {
          data.api.pause();
          return;
        }
        if (isElementInViewport()) {
          data.isVisible = true;
          data.api.play();
        }
      }

      data.checkAndPlayIfVisible = checkAndPlayIfVisible;

      function handleLoadError(error) {
        console.warn("Lottie failed to load:", src, error);
        root.dataset.lottieError = "true";
      }

      function onAnimationReady(svgRoot) {
        data.api.isReady = true;
        data.api.setSpeed(speed);
        data.api.setDirection(direction);
        data.svgRoot = svgRoot;

        if (svgRoot) {
          recolorSvg(svgRoot, pairs);
          startRecolorLoop();
        }

        checkAndPlayIfVisible();
      }

      if (isDotLottie && hasDot) {
        const player = document.createElement("dotlottie-player");
        player.setAttribute("src", src);
        player.setAttribute("renderer", "svg");
        player.setAttribute("autoplay", "false");
        player.setAttribute("loop", loop ? "true" : "false");
        player.style.width = "100%";
        player.style.height = "100%";
        host.innerHTML = "";
        host.appendChild(player);

        data.api = {
          isReady: false,
          play() { try { player.play(); } catch (e) { } },
          pause() { try { player.pause(); } catch (e) { } },
          setSpeed(n) { try { player.speed = Number(n) || 1; } catch (e) { } },
          setDirection(d) { try { player.direction = (d === -1 ? -1 : 1); } catch (e) { } },
          destroy() { try { player.remove(); } catch (e) { } }
        };

        player.addEventListener("ready", () => {
          const svgRoot = player.shadowRoot && player.shadowRoot.querySelector("svg");
          onAnimationReady(svgRoot);
        });

        player.addEventListener("error", handleLoadError);

      } else {
        const anim = window.lottie.loadAnimation({
          container: host,
          renderer: "svg",
          loop,
          autoplay: false,
          path: src
        });

        data.anim = anim;

        data.api = {
          isReady: false,
          play() { try { anim.play(); } catch (e) { } },
          pause() { try { anim.pause(); } catch (e) { } },
          setSpeed(n) { try { anim.setSpeed(Number(n) || 1); } catch (e) { } },
          setDirection(d) { try { anim.setDirection(d === -1 ? -1 : 1); } catch (e) { } },
          destroy() { try { anim.destroy(); } catch (e) { } }
        };

        anim.addEventListener("DOMLoaded", () => {
          const svgRoot = host.querySelector("svg");
          onAnimationReady(svgRoot);
        });

        anim.addEventListener("data_failed", handleLoadError);
        anim.addEventListener("error", handleLoadError);
      }

      const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(e => {
          const inView = e.isIntersecting && e.intersectionRatio >= OBS_THRESHOLD;
          data.isVisible = inView;

          if (!data.api || !data.api.isReady) return;

          if (prefersReducedMotion) {
            data.api.pause();
            return;
          }

          inView ? data.api.play() : data.api.pause();
        });
      }, { root: null, rootMargin: OBS_ROOT_MARGIN, threshold: OBS_THRESHOLD });

      io.observe(root);
      data.io = io;

      elementDataMap.set(root, data);
    }

    function cleanupElement(el) {
      const data = elementDataMap.get(el);
      if (data) {
        if (data.io) {
          try { data.io.disconnect(); } catch (e) { }
        }
        if (data.api && data.api.destroy) {
          try { data.api.destroy(); } catch (e) { }
        }
        elementDataMap.delete(el);
        stopRecolorLoopIfEmpty();
      }
      pendingElements.delete(el);
    }

    function checkAllVisibleElements() {
      elementDataMap.forEach((data) => {
        if (data.api && data.api.isReady && data.checkAndPlayIfVisible) {
          data.checkAndPlayIfVisible();
        }
      });
    }

    function init() {
      document.querySelectorAll(".pictogram_lottie_wrap").forEach(initLottieElement);

      if (document.readyState === "complete") {
        checkAllVisibleElements();
      } else {
        window.addEventListener("load", checkAllVisibleElements, { once: true });
      }

      const domObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
          mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (node.matches && node.matches(".pictogram_lottie_wrap")) {
                initLottieElement(node);
              }
              if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                node.querySelectorAll(".pictogram_lottie_wrap").forEach(initLottieElement);
              }
            }
          });

          mutation.removedNodes.forEach((node) => {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (node.matches && node.matches(".pictogram_lottie_wrap")) {
                cleanupElement(node);
              }
              if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                node.querySelectorAll(".pictogram_lottie_wrap").forEach(cleanupElement);
              }
            }
          });
        });
      });

      domObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
    } else {
      init();
    }

    window.PictogramLottie = {
      refresh: checkAllVisibleElements,
      init: initLottieElement,
      cleanup: cleanupElement
    };

  })();
</script></div></div></div></div><div data-animate-header-heading="" class="c-heading-header u-child-contain u-mb-text w-richtext u-max-width-30ch"><h2 aria-label="How you can use Claude"><div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">How</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">you</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">can</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">use</div> <div class="word" aria-hidden="true" style="position: relative; display: inline-block; opacity: 1; visibility: inherit;">Claude</div></h2></div><div data-wf--spacer--section-space="main" class="u-section-spacer w-variant-60a7ad7d-02b0-6682-95a5-2218e6fd1490 u-ignore-trim"></div></div><div data-animate-card-wrap="" data-tabs="component" data-wf--tab-component--variant="left-aligned-indent" class="tab_component w-variant-2fd97021-06ee-3a0e-e6b0-f34cc5814c51 u-grid-above" data-script-initialized="true"><div class="u-embed-css w-embed"><style>

</style></div><div class="u-embed-js w-embed w-script"><script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    // ---- tiny utilities ------------------------------------------------------
    function onDOMReady(cb) {
      if (
        document.readyState === "complete" ||
        document.readyState === "interactive"
      )
        cb();
      else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", cb, { once: true });
    }

    function whenGSAPReady(cb) {
      // Check for GSAP - improved approach without constant polling
      if (window.gsap) {
        cb();
      } else {
        var attempts = 0;
        var maxAttempts = 100; // 4 seconds max wait
        var checkGSAP = function() {
          if (window.gsap) {
            cb();
          } else if (attempts < maxAttempts) {
            attempts++;
            setTimeout(checkGSAP, 40);
          } else {
            console.error('GSAP failed to load after 4 seconds');
          }
        };
        checkGSAP();
      }
    }

    // Shared click handler for closing dropdowns (event delegation)
    var activeDropdowns = [];

    function globalClickHandler(e) {
      activeDropdowns.forEach(function(dropdown) {
        if (dropdown.isOpen &&
            !dropdown.btn.contains(e.target) &&
            !dropdown.menu.contains(e.target)) {
          dropdown.close();
        }
      });
    }

    // Only add the global click listener once
    var globalClickListenerAdded = false;
    function ensureGlobalClickListener() {
      if (!globalClickListenerAdded) {
        document.addEventListener("click", globalClickHandler);
        globalClickListenerAdded = true;
      }
    }

    // Check for reduced motion once
    var prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    // ---- initializer ---------------------------------------------------------
    function initTabsComponent(comp) {
      if (!comp || comp.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
      comp.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

      var menu = comp.querySelector('[data-tabs="menu"]');
      if (!menu) {
        console.warn("Tabs: menu not found", comp);
        return;
      }

      var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(
        menu.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs="tab"]')
      );
      var panels = Array.prototype.slice.call(
        comp.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs="panel"]')
      );

      // Get overflow elements
      var overflowParent = menu.querySelector('[data-tabs="overflow"]');
      var overflowBtn = menu.querySelector('[data-tabs="overflow-btn"]');
      var overflowMenu = menu.querySelector('[data-tabs="overflow-menu"]');
      var tabDropdownText = overflowBtn ? overflowBtn.querySelector('.tab_dropdown_text') : null;

      if (!tabs.length || !panels.length) {
        console.warn("Tabs: tabs or panels missing", comp);
        return;
      }

      // Dropdown state management
      var isDropdownOpen = false;

      // Initialize dropdown state
      function initDropdown() {
        if (!overflowParent || !overflowBtn || !overflowMenu) return;

        // Set initial state
        gsap.set(overflowMenu, {
          opacity: 0,
          y: 10,
          display: "none",
          pointerEvents: "none",
        });

        // Initialize dropdown text as hidden
        if (tabDropdownText) {
          tabDropdownText.style.display = 'none';
        }

        // Add click handler to dropdown button
        overflowBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggleDropdown();
        });

        // Register this dropdown for global click handling
        ensureGlobalClickListener();
        activeDropdowns.push({
          btn: overflowBtn,
          menu: overflowMenu,
          isOpen: false,
          close: closeDropdown,
          get isOpen() { return isDropdownOpen; }
        });
      }

      // Toggle dropdown open/close
      function toggleDropdown() {
        if (isDropdownOpen) {
          closeDropdown();
        } else {
          openDropdown();
        }
      }

      // Open dropdown with animation
      function openDropdown() {
        if (!overflowMenu || isDropdownOpen) return;

        isDropdownOpen = true;
        overflowBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

        gsap.set(overflowMenu, { display: "block" });
        gsap.to(overflowMenu, {
          opacity: 1,
          y: 0,
          duration: 0.3,
          ease: "power2.out",
          onComplete: function () {
            gsap.set(overflowMenu, { pointerEvents: "auto" });
          },
        });
      }

      // Close dropdown with animation
      function closeDropdown() {
        if (!overflowMenu || !isDropdownOpen) return;

        isDropdownOpen = false;
        overflowBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

        gsap.set(overflowMenu, { pointerEvents: "none" });
        gsap.to(overflowMenu, {
          opacity: 0,
          y: 10,
          duration: 0.2,
          ease: "power2.in",
          onComplete: function () {
            gsap.set(overflowMenu, { display: "none" });
          },
        });
      }

      // Manage dropdown text state
      function updateDropdownText(shouldShow, tabText) {
        if (!tabDropdownText) return;

        if (shouldShow && tabText) {
          tabDropdownText.style.display = 'flow-root';
          tabDropdownText.textContent = tabText;
        } else {
          tabDropdownText.style.display = 'none';
          tabDropdownText.textContent = '';
        }
      }

      // Get current dropdown button width including text
      function getDropdownButtonWidth() {
        if (!overflowBtn) return 50;

        // Temporarily show to measure if hidden
        var wasHidden = overflowParent.style.display === 'none';
        if (wasHidden) {
          overflowParent.style.display = 'block';
        }

        var width = overflowBtn.getBoundingClientRect().width;

        // Hide again if it was hidden
        if (wasHidden) {
          overflowParent.style.display = 'none';
        }

        return width || 50;
      }

      // Cache for tab widths to avoid repeated measurements
      var tabWidthCache = [];
      var cacheValid = false;

      function invalidateCache() {
        cacheValid = false;
      }

      function getTabWidth(index) {
        if (!cacheValid || !tabWidthCache[index]) {
          tabWidthCache[index] = tabs[index].getBoundingClientRect().width;
        }
        return tabWidthCache[index];
      }

      function calculateVisibleTabs(availableWidth) {
        var cumulativeWidth = 0;
        var visibleCount = 0;

        for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
          var tabWidth = getTabWidth(i);

          if (cumulativeWidth + tabWidth <= availableWidth) {
            cumulativeWidth += tabWidth;
            visibleCount++;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }

        return visibleCount;
      }

      function handleOverflowTabs() {
        if (!overflowParent || !overflowBtn || !overflowMenu) return;

        // Invalidate cache on recalculation
        invalidateCache();

        // Reset all tabs to visible for accurate measurement
        tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
          tab.style.display = 'flex';
        });

        // Measure the actual flex container (.tab_menu_inner)
        var parentRect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
        var parentWidth = parentRect.width;
        var style = getComputedStyle(menu);
        var paddingLeft = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0;
        var paddingRight = parseFloat(style.paddingRight) || 0;
        parentWidth = parentWidth - paddingLeft - paddingRight;

        // First pass: calculate without dropdown
        overflowParent.style.display = 'none';
        updateDropdownText(false);

        // Mark cache as valid for this calculation cycle
        cacheValid = true;

        var initialVisibleCount = calculateVisibleTabs(parentWidth);
        if (initialVisibleCount >= tabs.length) {
          // All fit, hide dropdown
          tabs.forEach(function(tab) { tab.style.display = 'flex'; });
          overflowMenu.innerHTML = '';
          return;
        }

        // Re-enable dropdown for split
        overflowParent.style.display = 'block';
        updateDropdownText(false);

        var dropdownWidth = getDropdownButtonWidth();
        var availableWidth = parentWidth - dropdownWidth;

        var visibleCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(calculateVisibleTabs(availableWidth), 5));
        var visibleTabs = tabs.slice(0, visibleCount);
        var overflowTabs = tabs.slice(visibleCount);

        // Hide overflow tabs
        overflowTabs.forEach(function (tab) { tab.style.display = 'none'; });

        // Populate dropdown
        overflowMenu.innerHTML = '';
        overflowTabs.forEach(function (tab) {
          var clone = tab.cloneNode(true);
          clone.style.display = 'flex';
          clone.classList.remove('is-active');
          clone.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
          clone.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
          clone.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            setActive(tabs.indexOf(tab));
            closeDropdown();
          });
          overflowMenu.appendChild(clone);
        });

        // If active tab is in dropdown, show its text
        var activeInDropdown = activeIndex >= visibleCount;
        if (activeInDropdown) {
          updateDropdownText(true, tabs[activeIndex].textContent.trim());
        }

        updateDropdownTabStates();
      }

      // Update active states in dropdown
      function updateDropdownTabStates() {
        if (!overflowParent || !overflowMenu) return;

        var dropdownTabs = overflowMenu.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs="tab"]');
        var activeTabInDropdown = tabs[activeIndex].style.display === 'none';

        dropdownTabs.forEach(function(dropdownTab, index) {
          var originalIndex = tabs.findIndex(function(tab) {
            return tab.textContent.trim() === dropdownTab.textContent.trim();
          });

          if (originalIndex === activeIndex) {
            dropdownTab.classList.add("is-active");
            dropdownTab.setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
            // Hide active tab in dropdown if it's shown in dropdown text
            if (activeTabInDropdown && tabDropdownText && tabDropdownText.style.display !== 'none') {
              dropdownTab.style.display = "none";
            } else {
              dropdownTab.style.display = "flex";
            }
          } else {
            dropdownTab.classList.remove("is-active");
            dropdownTab.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
            dropdownTab.style.display = "flex";
          }
        });
      }

      // Determine initial active tab
      var activeIndex = Math.max(
        0,
        tabs.findIndex
        ? tabs.findIndex(function (t) {
          return (
            t.classList.contains("is-active") ||
            t.getAttribute("aria-selected") === "true"
          );
        })
        : 0
      );

      // ARIA wiring
      tabs.forEach(function (t, i) {
        t.setAttribute("role", "tab");
        t.setAttribute("aria-selected", i === activeIndex ? "true" : "false");
        t.setAttribute("tabindex", i === activeIndex ? "0" : "-1");
      });
      panels.forEach(function (p, i) {
        p.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
        p.hidden = i !== activeIndex;
      });

      // Activate a tab/panel
      function setActive(index, conf) {
        conf = conf || {};
        if (index === activeIndex || index < 0 || index >= tabs.length) return;

        var prev = activeIndex;
        var next = index;
        var wasActiveTabInDropdown = tabs[prev].style.display === 'none';
        var newActiveTabInDropdown = tabs[next].style.display === 'none';

        tabs[prev].classList.remove("is-active");
        tabs[prev].setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
        tabs[prev].setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");

        tabs[next].classList.add("is-active");
        tabs[next].setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
        tabs[next].setAttribute("tabindex", "0");

        panels[prev].hidden = true;
        panels[next].hidden = false;
        activeIndex = next;

        const tabChangeEvent = new CustomEvent('tabchange', {
          detail: { tabComponent: comp, activeIndex: next, activePanel: panels[next] }
        });
        document.dispatchEvent(tabChangeEvent);

        // Always recalculate when switching contexts or between dropdown tabs
        var needsRecalculation = wasActiveTabInDropdown !== newActiveTabInDropdown ||
            (wasActiveTabInDropdown && newActiveTabInDropdown);

        if (needsRecalculation) {
          // Full recalculation to ensure correct layout
          handleOverflowTabs();
        }

        // Update dropdown states (if not already done by recalculation)
        if (!needsRecalculation) {
          updateDropdownTabStates();
        }

        // Stagger in the new panel's items - check reduced motion preference
        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          var items = panels[next].querySelectorAll("[data-stagger]");
          var targets = items.length ? items : panels[next].children;

          gsap.killTweensOf(targets);
          gsap.set(targets, { y: 40, autoAlpha: 0 });
          gsap.to(targets, {
            y: 0,
            autoAlpha: 1,
            duration: 0.65,
            ease: "power3.out",
            stagger: 0.1,
            delay: 0.2,
            overwrite: "auto",
            clearProps: "transform",
          });
        }
      }

      // Click + keyboard navigation
      tabs.forEach(function (tab, i) {
        tab.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setActive(i);
        });
        tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
          if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") {
            e.preventDefault();
            var next = (i + 1) % tabs.length;
            tabs[next].focus();
            setActive(next);
          } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
            e.preventDefault();
            var prev = (i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
            tabs[prev].focus();
            setActive(prev);
          }
        });
      });

      // Handle window resize with debouncing - iOS Safari fix
      var resizeTimer;
      var lastParentWidth = 0;

      function handleResize() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
          // Get current parent width
          var currentParentWidth = menu.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().width;

          // Only recalculate if width has meaningfully changed
          // This prevents iOS Safari viewport height changes from triggering recalculation
          if (Math.abs(currentParentWidth - lastParentWidth) > 5) {
            lastParentWidth = currentParentWidth;
            handleOverflowTabs();
          }
        }, 150);
      }

      window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

      // Initialize everything
      handleOverflowTabs();
      // Store initial width
      lastParentWidth = menu.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      initDropdown();

      // Enhanced cleanup function
      comp._tabsCleanup = function() {
        window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);

        // Remove from active dropdowns array
        activeDropdowns = activeDropdowns.filter(function(d) {
          return d.btn !== overflowBtn;
        });

        // Clear any pending timers
        if (resizeTimer) {
          clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        }

        // Invalidate cache
        invalidateCache();
        tabWidthCache = [];
      };
    }

    // boot: wait for DOM + GSAP, then init + observe
    onDOMReady(function () {
      whenGSAPReady(function () {
        // init any existing instances
        document
          .querySelectorAll("[data-tabs='component']")
          .forEach(initTabsComponent);

        // Observe future inserts (CMS Load, pagination, etc.)
        var mo = new MutationObserver(function (muts) {
          muts.forEach(function (m) {
            m.addedNodes.forEach(function (node) {
              if (!(node instanceof Element)) return;
              if (node.matches && node.matches("[data-tabs='component']")) {
                initTabsComponent(node);
              }
              var found = node.querySelectorAll
              ? node.querySelectorAll("[data-tabs='component']")
              : [];
              if (found.length) found.forEach(initTabsComponent);
            });
          });
        });
        mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      });
    });
  })();

  .artifact_document_rich_text *:first-child {
		margin-top: 0;
  }
</style></div><div class="artifact_document u-theme-light"><div class="artifact_document_rich_text w-richtext"><h3>Psychology 101 comprehensive study guide</h3><h4>Table of contents</h4><ul role="list"><li>Course overview</li><li>Lecture 1: What is psychology?</li><li>Lecture 2: Research methods</li><li>Practice questions</li><li>Study strategies</li></ul><h4>Course overview</h4><p><strong>Meeting times:</strong> MWF 10:10-11:00 AM, Lab Tuesdays 2:00-4:50 PM<br><strong>Office hours:</strong> Tuesdays 1-3 PM, Thursdays 11 AM-1 PM</p><h5>Key dates to remember</h5><ul role="list"><li><strong>February 21:</strong> Midterm exam 1</li><li><strong>March 7:</strong> Article critique due</li><li><strong>April 4:</strong> Midterm exam 2</li><li><strong>May 12:</strong> Final exam (8:00-11:00 AM)</li></ul><h5>Grade breakdown</h5><ul role="list"><li>Midterm exam 1: 20%</li><li>Midterm exam 2: 20%</li><li>Final exam: 30%</li><li>Research participation: 10%</li><li>Lab assignments &amp; quizzes: 10%</li><li>Class participation: 5%</li><li>Article critique: 5%</li></ul><h4>Lecture 1: What is psychology?</h4><h5>Core definition</h5><p>Psychology = The scientific study of behavior and mental processes</p><h5>Key characteristics of psychology as a science</h5><ul role="list"><li>Uses empirical methods (observation and experimentation)</li><li>Seeks to describe, explain, predict, and control behavior</li><li>Builds theories based on systematic research</li><li>Follows scientific method principles</li></ul><h5>Historical timeline</h5><h6>Philosophical roots (Ancient times - 1800s)</h6><p><strong>Ancient Greeks: Mind-body problem</strong></p><ul role="list"><li><strong>Plato:</strong> Mind separate from body (dualism)</li><li><strong>Aristotle:</strong> Mind and body connected (monism)</li></ul><p><strong>Later philosophers:</strong></p><ul role="list"><li><strong>René Descartes:</strong> Cartesian dualism</li><li><strong>John Locke:</strong> Empiricism and "blank slate" (tabula rasa)</li></ul><h6>Birth of scientific psychology (1879)</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Wilhelm Wundt:</strong> First psychology lab in Leipzig, Germany</li><li>Introduced introspection as research method</li><li><strong>Structuralism:</strong> Breaking consciousness into basic elements</li></ul><h5>Early schools of thought</h5><h6>Functionalism (William James, G. Stanley Hall)</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Focus:</strong> Purpose and adaptation of mental processes</li><li><strong>Key concept:</strong> "Stream of consciousness"</li></ul><h6>Behaviorism (John Watson, B.F. Skinner)</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Focus:</strong> Only observable behavior should be studied</li><li>Rejected introspection and consciousness</li><li><strong>Famous quote:</strong> "Give me a dozen healthy infants..."</li></ul><h6>Gestalt psychology (Max Wertheimer, Wolfgang Köhler)</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Key principle:</strong> "The whole is greater than the sum of its parts"</li><li>Emphasized perception and problem-solving</li></ul><h6>Psychoanalysis (Sigmund Freud)</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Focus:</strong> Unconscious mind drives behavior</li><li><strong>Methods:</strong> Dream analysis, free association</li><li><strong>Concepts:</strong> Defense mechanisms, psychosexual development</li></ul><h5>Modern psychological perspectives</h5><h6>Biological perspective</h6><ul role="list"><li>Brain structure and function</li><li>Neurotransmitters, hormones, genetics</li><li>Evolutionary influences</li></ul><h6>Cognitive perspective</h6><ul role="list"><li>Mental processes: thinking, memory, perception</li><li>Information processing model</li><li>Language and problem-solving</li></ul><h6>Behavioral perspective</h6><ul role="list"><li>Learning through conditioning</li><li>Environmental influences</li><li>Behavior modification</li></ul><h6>Humanistic perspective</h6><ul role="list"><li>Human potential and self-actualization</li><li>Free will and personal choice</li><li><strong>Carl Rogers:</strong> Unconditional positive regard</li><li><strong>Abraham Maslow:</strong> Hierarchy of needs</li></ul><h6>Psychodynamic perspective</h6><ul role="list"><li>Unconscious motivations</li><li>Early childhood experiences</li><li>Modern neo-Freudian approaches</li></ul><h6>Sociocultural perspective</h6><ul role="list"><li>Cultural influences on behavior</li><li>Social learning and modeling</li><li>Cross-cultural psychology</li></ul><h5>Major subfields</h5><h6>Basic research areas</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Experimental psychology:</strong> Laboratory studies of learning, memory, cognition</li><li><strong>Developmental psychology:</strong> Changes across lifespan</li><li><strong>Social psychology:</strong> How others influence our thoughts and behaviors</li><li><strong>Personality psychology:</strong> Individual differences and traits</li><li><strong>Biological/physiological psychology:</strong> Brain-behavior relationships</li></ul><h6>Applied areas</h6><ul role="list"><li><strong>Clinical psychology:</strong> Diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders</li><li><strong>Counseling psychology:</strong> Helping people with life problems</li><li><strong>Educational psychology:</strong> Learning and teaching processes</li><li><strong>Industrial/organizational psychology:</strong> Workplace behavior</li><li><strong>Health psychology:</strong> Psychological factors in physical health</li><li><strong>Forensic psychology:</strong> Psychology and legal system</li></ul><h4>Lecture 2: Research methods</h4><h5>The scientific method in psychology</h5><ol role="list"><li><strong>Observation and question formation</strong><ul role="list"><li>Notice patterns in behavior</li><li>Ask specific, testable questions</li></ul></li><li><strong>Literature review</strong><ul role="list"><li>Research existing studies</li><li>Identify gaps in knowledge</li></ul></li><li><strong>Hypothesis formation</strong><ul role="list"><li>Testable prediction about variables</li><li>Must be falsifiable</li></ul></li><li><strong>Research design → Data collection → Analysis → Interpretation → Replication</strong></li></ol><h5>Variables in psychological research</h5><h6>Independent variable (IV)</h6><ul role="list"><li>Variable manipulated by researcher</li><li>The "cause" in cause-and-effect relationship</li></ul><h6>Dependent variable (DV)</h6><ul role="list"><li>Variable measured by researcher</li><li>The "effect" in cause-and-effect relationship</li></ul><h6>Confounding variables</h6><ul role="list"><li>Unwanted variables that might influence results</li><li>Must be controlled or eliminated</li></ul><h4>Types of research methods</h4><h5>Descriptive methods</h5><p><em>Note: Observe and describe, cannot determine cause-and-effect</em></p><h5>Case studies</h5><ul role="list"><li>In-depth study of individual</li><li>Examples: Phineas Gage, H.M.</li></ul><h5>Surveys</h5><ul role="list"><li>Questionnaires/interviews with large groups</li></ul><h5>Naturalistic observation</h5><ul role="list"><li>Observe behavior in natural environment</li></ul><h5>Correlational research</h5><ul role="list"><li>Examines relationships between variables</li><li>Correlation coefficient (r) ranges from -1.00 to +1.00</li><li><strong>CRITICAL:</strong> Correlation does NOT equal causation!</li><li>Third variable problem: Unknown factor might cause both</li></ul><h5>Experimental method</h5><ul role="list"><li>The ONLY method that can determine cause-and-effect relationships</li><li><strong>Key features:</strong> Random assignment, manipulation of IV, control of variables</li></ul><h4>Ethics in psychological research</h4><ul role="list"><li><strong>Informed consent:</strong> Participants must understand what they're agreeing to</li><li><strong>Deception and debriefing:</strong> Minimal deception, full explanation after</li><li><strong>Confidentiality:</strong> Protect participants' privacy</li><li><strong>Risk-benefit analysis:</strong> Benefits must outweigh risks</li></ul><h4>Practice questions</h4><h5>Lecture 1: What is psychology?</h5><h6>Multiple choice</h6><ol role="list"><li>Psychology is best defined as the scientific study of:<ul role="list"><li>a) Mental illness</li><li>b) Behavior and mental processes</li><li>c) The brain and nervous system</li><li>d) Human interactions</li></ul></li><li>Who established the first psychology laboratory?<ul role="list"><li>a) William James</li><li>b) John Watson</li><li>c) Wilhelm Wundt</li><li>d) Sigmund Freud</li></ul></li><li>The belief that "the whole is greater than the sum of its parts" is associated with:<ul role="list"><li>a) Behaviorism</li><li>b) Functionalism</li><li>c) Gestalt psychology</li><li>d) Psychoanalysis</li></ul></li></ol><h6>Short answer</h6><ol role="list"><li>Explain the difference between dualism and monism in the mind-body problem.</li><li>Compare and contrast structuralism and functionalism.</li><li>Which psychological perspective would be most likely to study how brain chemistry affects mood? Explain your answer.</li></ol><h5>Lecture 2: Research methods</h5><h6>Multiple choice</h6><ol role="list"><li>In an experiment studying the effects of caffeine on memory, caffeine would be the:<ul role="list"><li>a) Dependent variable</li><li>b) Independent variable</li><li>c) Confounding variable</li><li>d) Control variable</li></ul></li><li>A correlation coefficient of -0.85 indicates:<ul role="list"><li>a) A weak negative relationship</li><li>b) A strong positive relationship</li><li>c) A strong negative relationship</li><li>d) No relationship</li></ul></li><li>Which research method is the ONLY one that can establish cause-and-effect relationships?<ul role="list"><li>a) Case study</li><li>b) Survey</li><li>c) Correlational study</li><li>d) Experimental method</li></ul></li></ol><h6>Application scenarios</h6><ol role="list"><li>A researcher finds that students who study with music score lower on tests than those who study in silence. The researcher concludes that music causes poor test performance. What's wrong with this conclusion?</li><li>Design a simple experiment to test whether exercise improves mood. Identify the IV, DV, and potential confounding variables.</li></ol><h6>Ethics scenario</h6><p>A researcher wants to study the effects of stress on problem-solving but doesn't tell participants they'll be stressed because it might affect their behavior. Is this ethical? What ethical principles are involved?</p><h3>Study strategies</h3><h5>For memorizing definitions</h5><ul role="list"><li>Create flashcards for key terms</li><li>Use the terms in original sentences</li><li>Connect terms to real-world examples</li><li>Practice explaining concepts to others</li></ul><h5>For understanding research methods</h5><ul role="list"><li>Practice identifying IV and DV in research scenarios</li><li>Create your own simple experimental designs</li><li>Look for research examples in news articles</li><li>Practice explaining why correlation ≠ causation</li></ul><h5>For historical information</h5><ul role="list"><li>Create a timeline of psychology's development</li><li>Make concept maps connecting related ideas</li><li>Use the provided mnemonics</li><li>Focus on how each approach built on or reacted to previous ones</li></ul><h5>For connecting perspectives to behavior</h5><ul role="list"><li>Take any behavior (e.g., helping others) and explain it from each perspective</li><li>Practice identifying which perspective would be most interested in specific research questions</li><li>Create charts comparing how different perspectives would approach the same problem</li></ul><h5>Exam preparation tips</h5><ul role="list"><li>Review lecture notes within 24 hours of class</li><li>Complete practice questions after each topic</li><li>Form study groups to discuss concepts</li><li>Use active recall rather than just re-reading</li><li>Connect new material to previously learned concepts</li><li>Attend office hours for clarification on difficult topics</li></ul><h4>Final review checklist</h4><h5>Before midterm 1:</h5><ul role="list"><li> Can define psychology and its key characteristics</li><li> Know major historical figures and their contributions</li><li> Understand all six modern perspectives</li><li> Can identify different subfields of psychology</li><li> Understand research methods and variables</li><li> Know ethical principles</li><li> Can analyze research scenarios</li></ul><h5>Study resources:</h5><ul role="list"><li>Textbook chapters 1-2</li><li>Lecture notes and recordings</li><li>Lab manual exercises</li><li>Practice quizzes on Canvas</li><li>Office hours for clarification on difficult topics</li><li>Study groups with classmates</li></ul><p><strong>Remember:</strong> Focus on understanding concepts rather than just memorizing facts. Psychology builds on itself, so master these foundations for success throughout the course!</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-wf--background-color--background-color="clay" </style></div><div class="artifact_document u-theme-light"><div class="artifact_document_rich_text w-richtext"><h3>Adaptive business model framework for shifting consumer behavior patterns post-2024</h3><h4>Executive summary</h4><p>The business landscape in 2025 is characterized by permanent disruption, where traditional consumer behavior models no longer apply. What once seemed like short-term adaptations born of the COVID-19 pandemic have solidified into lasting behavioral change. Organizations must develop adaptive business models that can respond to five key behavioral forces: increased digital-first behaviors, declining trust in digital channels, Gen Z's growing economic influence, local preference trends, and new value-seeking patterns.</p><p>This framework provides a systematic approach for businesses to transform their operations, embrace continuous adaptation, and thrive in an environment where consumer sentiment is no longer neatly aligned with consumer spending. Success requires moving from reactive adjustments to proactive transformation through four strategic imperatives: deep consumer understanding, advanced revenue growth management, dynamic portfolio optimization, and technology capability rewiring.</p><h4>Key consumer behavior shifts driving business model adaptation</h4><h5>Digital-first convenience expectations</h5><p>The behaviors that consumers adopted for coping with life under COVID-19 lockdown—namely, a reliance on digital connectivity and at-home activities—are now permanent parts of their daily lives. This shift has created several critical implications:</p><p><strong>Time allocation changes</strong>: US consumers in 2025 report that they have over three hours more of free time a week, on average, than those in 2019 reported. But they allocate nearly 90 percent of that time to solo activities. The biggest increases are in hobbies, shopping, fitness, and social media engagement.</p><p><strong>Delivery expectations</strong>: Food delivery's share of global food service spending rose from 9 percent in 2019 to 21 percent in 2024. Consumers now expect seamless delivery across categories, with over one-third of consumers across all four regions identifying Amazon or Taobao as their go-to shopping destination for all their needs.</p><p><strong>Convenience premium</strong>: Over 80% of consumers look up brands on platforms like Instagram and TikTok before buying. Almost 70% have made purchases directly through social channels, and nearly 30% buy on the same day they discover something new.</p><h5>Trust paradox in digital channels</h5><p>A fundamental contradiction exists in consumer digital behavior. Consumers tell us that social media is their least trusted source when making buying decisions, yet it's where they interact with family and friends, who serve as their most trusted sources. This creates complex dynamics:</p><p><strong>Influence vs trust</strong>: While social media has low trust ratings, we see an increase in social media use for product research (32 percent, on average, compared with 27 percent in 2023). In emerging markets, approximately half of consumers research products on social media before purchasing.</p><p><strong>Cross-generational adoption</strong>: Digital engagement is no longer age-restricted. 33 percent of Gen Xers surveyed across Europe and the United States state that they're on TikTok, while 35 percent of baby boomers in those regions report that they're on Instagram.</p><h5>Gen Z economic emergence</h5><p>Gen Zers (born between 1996 and 2010) are projected to make up not only the largest generation but also the wealthiest in history. Their economic impact is substantial:</p><p><strong>Income growth</strong>: The average 25-year-old Gen Z consumer in the United States has a household income of $40,000, 50 percent higher than the average baby boomer's at the same age.</p><p><strong>Spending acceleration</strong>: Gen Z spending, which is growing twice as fast as previous generations' spending did at the same age, is on pace to eclipse baby boomers' spending globally by 2029. By 2035, Gen Zers will add an additional $8.9 trillion to the global economy.</p><p><strong>Value priorities</strong>: Gen Zers across markets are less likely than members of older generations to define themselves based on life stage milestones, such as getting married and having children. They're much more likely, however, to define themselves based on achievements related to financial security.</p><p><strong>Financial behavior</strong>: Despite financial concerns, more than one-quarter of surveyed Gen Z respondents report using buy-now-pay-later services to make a purchase, and 34 percent of surveyed Gen Zers report a willingness to buy on credit, which is about 13 percentage points higher than other generations.</p><h5>Local preference movement</h5><p>Over the past five years, we have seen disruptor consumer brands encroach on global, multinational brands. That trend has evolved in 2025: consumers are signaling the importance of buying local from their own markets.</p><p><strong>Local preference statistics</strong>: Globally, 47 percent of consumers identify locally owned companies as important to their purchase decision. The primary motivation is supporting domestic businesses (36% of consumers), followed by better needs alignment (20%).</p><p><strong>Regional variations</strong>: This trend is particularly strong in certain markets. In China, six of the top ten beauty brands with the most market share growth since 2020 are Chinese (up from only two from 2015 to 2020). In Japan, nine of the top ten snack brands are Japanese.</p><h5>Value redefinition patterns</h5><p>Consumer value-seeking behavior has become increasingly sophisticated and cross-category. Rising prices continue to be the number-one cause for concern among consumers across all 18 of the markets in our survey.</p><p><strong>Trading down complexity</strong>: Globally, 79 percent of surveyed consumers are trading down but not necessarily by purchasing fewer items or seeking discounts at lower-priced retailers. Instead, more than half of surveyed consumers across markets say that they look for deals on every purchase.</p><p><strong>Cross-category optimization</strong>: Cross-category trade-downs—trading down in one category to afford something in another—are becoming more prevalent. In the first half of 2025, more than one-third of consumers surveyed state that they have traded down in one category while planning to splurge in another.</p><p><strong>Splurging persistence</strong>: Even among consumers who state that they're concerned about rising prices, over one-third still have plans to splurge, indicating selective value optimization rather than across-the-board reduction.</p><h4>Adaptive business model framework components</h4><h5>Framework overview</h5><p>The adaptive business model framework consists of four interconnected layers that enable organizations to respond dynamically to shifting consumer behaviors:</p><ol role="list"><li><strong>Sensing layer</strong>: Continuous market intelligence and consumer insight generation</li><li><strong>Strategy layer</strong>: Adaptive strategic planning and portfolio management</li><li><strong>Execution layer</strong>: Agile operations and technology infrastructure</li><li><strong>Learning layer</strong>: Feedback loops and continuous optimization</li></ol><p>This framework recognizes that companies must be really good at learning how to do new things. Those that thrive are quick to read and act on weak signals of change.</p><h5>Layer 1: Sensing layer - Consumer intelligence systems</h5><h6>Real-time consumer monitoring</h6><p>Organizations must build comprehensive consumer intelligence capabilities that go beyond traditional market research. This includes:</p><ul role="list"><li>AI-powered social listening tools that track sentiment across platforms</li><li>Behavioral analytics from owned digital properties</li><li>Third-party data integration for broader market insights</li><li>Predictive analytics for early trend identification</li></ul><h6>Cross-generational insight capture</h6><p>Given the complexity of modern consumer segments, organizations need specialized approaches for different demographic groups:</p><ul role="list"><li>Gen Z engagement through native digital channels and micro-influencer partnerships</li><li>Millennial focus on convenience and value optimization</li><li>Gen X and Boomer digital adoption monitoring</li><li>Cultural and regional preference tracking</li></ul><h6>Value perception analysis</h6><p>Understanding how consumers define and seek value requires sophisticated measurement:</p><ul role="list"><li>Cross-category spending pattern analysis</li><li>Trade-down and splurge behavior prediction</li><li>Price sensitivity modeling across segments</li><li>Local vs global brand preference tracking</li></ul><h5>Layer 2: Strategy layer - Dynamic strategic planning</h5><h6>Adaptive portfolio management</h6><p>Consumer players should strive to generate 20 to 30 percent new revenue from their portfolio every ten years. This requires:</p><p><strong>Continuous portfolio evaluation</strong>: Regular assessment of brand performance across markets with local preference considerations. Organizations should evaluate which brands can successfully operate beyond core markets and which should be localized or divested.</p><p><strong>Strategic M&amp;A approach</strong>: Those that leverage M&amp;A&amp;D for growth generate 2.5 percentage points more TSR than those with organic growth alone do. Focus areas include:</p><ul role="list"><li>Local brand acquisition in key markets</li><li>Technology capability acquisitions</li><li>Vertical integration for supply chain control</li><li>Platform business model acquisitions</li></ul><p><strong>Innovation pipeline management</strong>: Systematic approach to new product and service development based on emerging consumer behaviors, including convenience-focused offerings and digitally-native experiences.</p><h6>Revenue growth management (RGM) optimization</h6><p>Offering the right product at the right price at the right time has become more important and harder to do than ever. Advanced RGM requires:</p><p><strong>Dynamic pricing strategies</strong>: AI-powered pricing models that respond to consumer value-seeking behaviors and cross-category trade-offs.</p><p><strong>Personalized promotion deployment</strong>: Targeted promotional spending that reaches consumers at optimal moments with relevant offers.</p><p><strong>Channel optimization</strong>: Strategic presence across discount, wholesale, and premium channels to capture different value-seeking behaviors.</p><p><strong>Partnership innovation</strong>: Collaborative data sharing with retailers for advanced analytics and retail media activation.</p><h5>Layer 3: Execution layer - Agile operations</h5><h6>Technology capability rewiring</h6><p>Consumer businesses that make long-term, transformative investments in rewiring for growth could unlock up to a 15-percentage-point improvement in EBITDA margins. Priority areas include:</p><p><strong>AI and automation integration</strong>: Implementation of agentic AI for consumer insights, demand management, and channel optimization. Among the 140 agentic AI and gen AI use cases that consumer players should prioritize, shaping consumer insights and demand and managing customers and channels represent the greatest value.</p><p><strong>Omnichannel infrastructure</strong>: Seamless integration across digital and physical touchpoints to meet convenience expectations.</p><p><strong>Supply chain agility</strong>: Flexible supply chain configuration to support local preferences and rapid portfolio changes.</p><p><strong>Data architecture modernization</strong>: Real-time data processing capabilities for dynamic decision-making.</p><h6>Experience design optimization</h6><p>Based on changing consumer expectations, organizations must redesign core experiences:</p><p><strong>Convenience maximization</strong>: Reduction of friction at every touchpoint, with particular focus on delivery speed and reliability.</p><p><strong>Trust building mechanisms</strong>: Authentic communication strategies that leverage trusted sources like family and friends while maintaining digital presence.</p><p><strong>Local market customization</strong>: Tailored offerings that reflect local tastes, trends, and cultural preferences.</p><p><strong>Value communication</strong>: Clear articulation of value propositions that resonate with cross-category optimization behaviors.</p><h5>Layer 4: Learning layer - Continuous adaptation</h5><h6>Feedback loop optimization</h6><p>Systematic capture and integration of performance data to drive continuous improvement:</p><p><strong>Consumer behavior tracking</strong>: Regular monitoring of behavioral changes and preference shifts across demographics.</p><p><strong>Performance analytics</strong>: Real-time assessment of strategic initiative effectiveness with rapid course correction capabilities.</p><p><strong>Competitive intelligence</strong>: Ongoing analysis of disruptive brands and emerging business models.</p><p><strong>Trend anticipation</strong>: Proactive identification of weak signals that could indicate major behavioral shifts.</p><h6>Organizational learning culture</h6><p>Adaptive strategy execution is a sure-fire way of encouraging flexibility, close communication, and routine operational assessments, ensuring ongoing alignment with internal and external changes. This requires:</p><p><strong>Agility mindset</strong>: Organization-wide embrace of experimentation and rapid iteration.</p><p><strong>Cross-functional collaboration</strong>: Breaking down silos to enable rapid response to consumer insights.</p><p><strong>Decision authority distribution</strong>: Empowering frontline teams to make rapid adjustments based on consumer feedback.</p><p><strong>Knowledge sharing systems</strong>: Systematic capture and distribution of learnings across the organization.</p><h4>Implementation roadmap</h4><h5>Phase 1: Foundation building (Months 1-6)</h5><h6><strong>Sensing capability development</strong></h6><ul role="list"><li>Implement AI-powered social listening tools</li><li>Establish real-time behavioral analytics from owned properties</li><li>Create consumer segmentation models that reflect new behavioral patterns</li><li>Build cross-category spending analysis capabilities</li></ul><h6><strong>Strategic assessment</strong></h6><ul role="list"><li>Conduct comprehensive business model analysis using adapted frameworks</li><li>Evaluate portfolio performance against local preference trends</li><li>Assess current pricing and promotional effectiveness</li><li>Review technology infrastructure readiness</li></ul><h6><strong>Organizational preparation</strong></h6><ul role="list"><li>Establish adaptive strategy execution teams</li><li>Implement agile planning processes</li><li>Create cross-functional consumer insight sharing mechanisms</li><li>Begin culture transformation toward experimentation mindset</li></ul><h5>Phase 2: Strategy activation (Months 7-12)</h5><h6>Consumer-centric transformation</h6><p>Build 360-degree consumer view capabilities:</p><ul role="list"><li>Deploy predictive analytics for churn risk and product preferences</li><li>Implement personalized recommendation engines</li><li>Create dynamic customer journey optimization</li><li>Establish granular behavioral data collection from owned channels</li></ul><h6>Revenue growth management advancement</h6><p>Implement advanced RGM capabilities:</p><ul role="list"><li>Deploy AI-powered pricing optimization models</li><li>Create real-time promotional effectiveness tracking</li><li>Establish strategic retailer partnerships with data sharing agreements</li><li>Implement assortment optimization based on local preferences</li></ul><h6>Portfolio optimization initiation</h6><p>Begin strategic portfolio moves:</p><ul role="list"><li>Identify underperforming brands in local markets</li><li>Evaluate acquisition targets for local market entry</li><li>Assess vertical integration opportunities</li><li>Plan innovation pipeline based on behavioral insights</li></ul><h5>Phase 3: Execution excellence (Months 13-18)</h5><h6>Technology capability rewiring</h6><p>Execute major technology transformation:</p><ul role="list"><li>Implement agentic AI for consumer insights and demand management</li><li>Deploy advanced analytics infrastructure</li><li>Create omnichannel experience platforms</li><li>Establish real-time decision-making capabilities</li></ul><h6>Experience optimization</h6><p>Transform consumer-facing experiences:</p><ul role="list"><li>Launch convenience-focused service improvements</li><li>Implement trust-building communication strategies</li><li>Deploy locally-customized offerings</li><li>Create value-focused messaging frameworks</li></ul><h6>Operational agility enhancement</h6><p>Build responsive operational capabilities:</p><ul role="list"><li>Establish supply chain flexibility for rapid portfolio changes</li><li>Create dynamic pricing and promotion systems</li><li>Implement cross-category optimization tools</li><li>Deploy real-time performance monitoring</li></ul><h5>Phase 4: Continuous adaptation (Months 19-24 and ongoing)</h5><h6>Learning system optimization</h6><p>Create systematic learning and adaptation mechanisms:</p><ul role="list"><li>Implement continuous consumer behavior monitoring</li><li>Establish weak signal detection systems</li><li>Create rapid experimentation frameworks</li><li>Deploy automated course correction capabilities</li></ul><h6>Competitive advantage solidification</h6><p>Build sustainable differentiation:</p><ul role="list"><li>Develop unique consumer insight capabilities</li><li>Create proprietary prediction models</li><li>Establish exclusive partnership networks</li><li>Build innovation pipeline management systems</li></ul><h6>Culture and capability maturation</h6><p>Embed adaptive mindset across the organization:</p><ul role="list"><li>Complete organizational structure transformation</li><li>Establish continuous learning programs</li><li>Create innovation and experimentation rewards systems</li><li>Build cross-functional collaboration protocols</li></ul><h4>Success metrics and monitoring</h4><h5>Leading indicators</h5><h6>Consumer engagement metrics</h6><ul role="list"><li>Social listening sentiment trends across platforms</li><li>Customer lifetime value progression by segment</li><li>Cross-category purchase correlation analysis</li><li>Local brand preference scores in target markets</li></ul><h6>Behavioral prediction accuracy</h6><ul role="list"><li>Consumer behavior model prediction precision</li><li>Trend identification lead time</li><li>Value-seeking pattern anticipation accuracy</li><li>Splurge vs trade-down forecasting effectiveness</li></ul><h6>Strategic agility indicators</h6><ul role="list"><li>Time from consumer insight to strategic action</li><li>Portfolio adaptation speed</li><li>Innovation pipeline velocity</li><li>Market entry/exit decision effectiveness</li></ul><h5>Lagging indicators</h5><h6>Financial performance</h6><ul role="list"><li>Revenue growth from new behavioral pattern adaptation</li><li>Market share gains in key demographics</li><li>EBITDA margin improvement from technology rewiring</li><li>Total shareholder return vs. industry benchmarks</li></ul><h6>Market position strength</h6><ul role="list"><li>Brand preference scores vs. competitors</li><li>Consumer trust ratings across channels</li><li>Local market penetration rates</li><li>Cross-generational engagement levels</li></ul><h6>Operational excellence</h6><ul role="list"><li>Consumer experience scores</li><li>Time-to-market for new initiatives</li><li>Technology system performance metrics</li><li>Supply chain flexibility indicators</li></ul><h4>Risk management and mitigation</h4><h5>Technology risks</h5><p><strong>Data privacy and security</strong>: As organizations collect more granular consumer data, privacy regulations and security requirements intensify. Mitigation includes implementing privacy-by-design principles, ensuring GDPR and CCPA compliance, and building robust cybersecurity frameworks.</p><p><strong>AI model bias and accuracy</strong>: Predictive models may perpetuate biases or lose accuracy as consumer behaviors evolve. Regular model auditing, diverse training data, and continuous retraining protocols are essential.</p><p><strong>Technology integration complexity</strong>: Rewiring technology capabilities involves significant integration challenges. Phased implementation, extensive testing, and change management programs reduce integration risks.</p><h5>Market risks</h5><p><strong>Consumer behavior volatility</strong>: Rapid changes in consumer preferences could outpace adaptation capabilities. Building flexible systems and maintaining diverse portfolio options provides resilience.</p><p><strong>Competitive response</strong>: Competitors may quickly copy successful adaptations. Developing proprietary capabilities and first-mover advantages in niche segments provides differentiation.</p><p><strong>Economic disruption</strong>: Economic downturns could dramatically shift consumer value-seeking behaviors. Scenario planning and flexible cost structures enable rapid response.</p><h5>Organizational risks</h5><p><strong>Change resistance</strong>: Employees may resist adaptive transformation requirements. Comprehensive change management, clear communication of benefits, and performance incentive alignment support adoption.</p><p><strong>Capability gaps</strong>: Organizations may lack skills needed for advanced analytics and adaptive operations. Strategic hiring, training programs, and external partnerships address capability needs.</p><p><strong>Resource allocation conflicts</strong>: Competing priorities may limit transformation investment. Clear ROI demonstration and phased implementation help secure sustained investment.</p><h4>Conclusion</h4><p>The post-2024 consumer landscape represents a fundamental shift that requires businesses to move beyond traditional reactive adjustments toward proactive adaptive transformation. A new baseline has emerged for consumer decision-making. Despite a high level of uncertainty—not only in consumer sentiment, but also in geopolitical and economic outlook—there are many areas in which brands can find growth.</p><p>Success in this environment requires organizations to embrace four strategic imperatives: building deep consumer understanding capabilities, implementing advanced revenue growth management, continuously optimizing portfolio composition, and rewiring technology capabilities for adaptive operations. Organizations that implement this framework systematically will be positioned to thrive in an environment where outcompeting in the coming years means anticipating the needs of an often-unpredictable consumer.</p><p>The adaptive business model framework provides a systematic approach for this transformation, emphasizing continuous learning, rapid experimentation, and consumer-centric decision making. Organizations that successfully implement this framework will not only survive the current disruption but establish sustainable competitive advantages in the evolving consumer economy.</p><p>By recognizing that brands that can swiftly adapt to the new realities will be well positioned to grow, regardless of the uncertainty ahead, forward-thinking organizations can transform disruption from threat to opportunity, building resilient business models that thrive on change rather than merely enduring it.</p><p>—</p><p><em>This framework synthesizes insights from extensive consumer behavior research across 18 global markets representing 75% of global GDP, incorporating strategic frameworks from leading consulting organizations and academic research on adaptive business systems.</em></p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-wf--background-color--background-color="coral" class="background_wrap w-variant-f2368458-8f5d-e731-bc27-e4954f607dd2 showing a complex business initiative rollout across different enterprise departments. Include overlapping timelines, milestone markers, and progress indicators. Use the uploaded timeline data to show how HR, Data Analysis, Product Management, Sales, and Marketing teams can execute concurrent project phases with dependencies.
